title: Primavera Unifier Solution Architect
description:
About Us:
Consertus is a global capital program management and advisory firm that combines deep human expertise with advanced digital tools to deliver smarter, faster, and more sustainable outcomes. Headquartered in Miami, Florida, and supported by a team of more than 1,000 professionals worldwide, we help clients plan, execute, and optimize large-scale capital programs.
Our integrated services span digital, advisory, and delivery, empowering organizations to navigate complexity, manage risk, and achieve strategic goals in sectors including aviation, transportation, transit, water, healthcare, energy, education, government, commercial, life sciences, and technology.
At Consertus, we celebrate individual strengths, foster strong relationships, and promote flexibility in how and where we work. Join us to grow your career, develop your skills, and make a lasting impact as we transform how the world is built.
Discover how Consertus is driving transformative change for our clients, our people, and the communities we serve at 
www.consertus.com
  
About this Role: 
The Unifier Solution Architect designs and leads the delivery of Oracle Primavera Unifier solutions that replace manual, paper, and spreadsheet-based processes with a governed, scalable system of record. This role partners with business and project stakeholders to define requirements, translate them into Unifier configurations, and ensure solutions are usable, maintainable, and aligned to program controls and governance.
Key Responsibilities:
Lead the design of Unifier and other PMIS solutions 
Work directly with clients to gather requirements, make recommendations, take detailed notes, and convey those to other members of the project team 
Create strategy documents, such as integration strategy, PMIS strategy, training strategy, etc
Create detailed design documentation, and artifacts
Work with developers and development leads to manage Unifier/PMIS development
Be able to create proof of concepts to demonstrate key functionality
Quality assurance on solutions developed by digital teams
Execute UAT process and obtain final sign off from clients
Assist with the development of integration and migration plans 
Escalate any issues promptly to project leadership
Demo solutions to clients 
Ability to manage shifting priorities and adapt quickly 
Support sales process as needed
Required Skills and Experience: 
5+ Years Experience with Oracle Primavera Unifier or similar PMIS
3+ Years Solution Architecture experience with Unifier or similar PMIS
Excellent communication skills (virtual meetings, phone calls, emails, etc)
Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite
Nice to Have:
2-3 Years Construction experience
Experience with building Integrations
Power BI experience
Education:
Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, or Information Technology (or equivalent).

title: Senior Cost Manager/Program Controls Manager
description:
About Us:
Consertus is a global capital program management and advisory firm that combines deep human expertise with advanced digital tools to deliver smarter, faster, and more sustainable outcomes. Headquartered in Miami, Florida, and supported by a team of more than 1,000 professionals worldwide, we help clients plan, execute, and optimize large-scale capital programs.
Our integrated services span digital, advisory, and delivery, empowering organizations to navigate complexity, manage risk, and achieve strategic goals in sectors including aviation, transportation, transit, water, healthcare, energy, education, government, commercial, life sciences, and technology.
At Consertus, we celebrate individual strengths, foster strong relationships, and promote flexibility in how and where we work. Join us to grow your career, develop your skills, and make a lasting impact as we transform how the world is built.

About this Role: 
Consertus is seeking a 
Senior Cost Manager/Senior Program Controls Manager
 
(Healthcare Capital Programs)
 based out of 
Seattle, WA.
 In this role, you will wear two hats, own end-to-end cost management while also providing senior-level program controls support to integrate cost, schedule, and risk into clear, decision-ready reporting. This individual contributor role is accountable for budget governance, forecast (EAC) accuracy, and executive-ready insights across multiple projects, partnering closely with project management, healthcare clients, and technical stakeholders to drive financial transparency, risk management, and cost performance.
The ideal candidate brings strong construction cost management experience, knowledge of healthcare environments, and the versatility to move between detailed analysis and program-level controls leadership. You are comfortable switching from building forecasts, validating pay applications, and managing change/trends to facilitating controls cadence, aligning stakeholders, and translating complex data into clear narratives and recommendations. Success in this role requires influencing outcomes without direct authority, proactively surfacing risks and opportunities, and driving timely decisions through stakeholder alignment.
Key Responsibilities
Lead cost management for a portfolio of healthcare-related construction and infrastructure projects (hospitals, clinics, campus utilities), establishing consistent cost coding/WBS alignment and reporting governance.
Own project/program budgets, committed costs, forecast (EAC), and cash flow from preconstruction through closeout; ensure forecast integrity through disciplined reviews and variance explanations.
Develop and maintain cost trend and risk registers; evaluate impacts to contingency, escalation, and exposure, and recommend mitigation actions and recovery plans.
Lead cost change control by evaluating scope/design/phasing changes, maintaining change logs, and supporting negotiation strategy with clear entitlement and backup documentation.
Reconcile contractor/consultant cost reports with Consertus and client systems; challenge assumptions and align stakeholders on a single source of truth.
Prepare executive-ready weekly and monthly cost reports and narratives, including key drivers, variances, risks/opportunities, decisions required, and forward-looking outlook.
Partner with Project Managers, Project Controls, Scheduling, and Accounting to integrate schedule progress, quantities, and earned progress into accurate cost-to-complete forecasting.
Review and validate pay applications, invoices, and cost accruals as applicable; support audit-ready documentation and compliance with client/owner requirements.
Track job cost performance against KPIs and healthcare-specific constraints (phasing, infection control, stakeholder coordination), escalating concerns early with recommended options.
Support project closeout, including validation of final costs, change reconciliation, lessons learned, and support for owner audits and financial turnover.
Interface with owner representatives, design teams, and contractors to lead cost review meetings, drive timely responses, and maintain transparency across stakeholders.
Continuously improve cost management processes, templates, and controls; coach project teams on best practices to improve consistency and auditability (without direct people management responsibility).
Qualifications
Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Finance, Accounting, or a related field
7+ years of progressive experience in construction cost management/cost engineering, preferably on healthcare, institutional, or large-scale infrastructure capital programs
Demonstrated ownership of budgets, committed cost, forecast (EAC), and cash flow, with the ability to explain variances and forecast drivers to executive and non-financial stakeholders
Strong working knowledge of construction accounting principles, cost forecasting, project controls, and cost governance (coding structures, controls, auditability)
Experience with change control, trend/risk management, contingency planning, and cost-to-complete development across design and construction phases
Proficiency with cost control and reporting tools; experience with cost management systems and dashboards required.
Ability to influence outcomes without direct authority; strong facilitation skills for cost review meetings and stakeholder alignment
High attention to detail, organization, and follow-through in a fast-paced, multi-project environment
Familiarity with the unique challenges of working on active healthcare campuses (phasing, infection control, stakeholder coordination) is a plus
Preferred: CCP (AACE), CCM (CMAA), PMP, or equivalent certification
Senior Program Controls Manager – Additional Requirements (Preferred):
7+ years of progressive experience in project/program controls on large capital programs; supporting multi-project portfolios or program management offices (PMO)
Demonstrated expertise integrating cost, schedule, and risk into a cohesive controls framework (baseline development, updates, variance analysis, and corrective-action planning)
Advanced proficiency with scheduling and controls tools (Primavera P6 preferred) and program controls platforms/reporting (e.g., Unifier, EcoSys, SAP/Oracle, Power BI), including data governance and auditability
Experience establishing and enforcing program controls standards: progress measurement rules, change control workflows, monthly reporting cadence, and KPI definitions
Strong capability in schedule health assessment, critical path evaluation, and schedule-driven forecasting; ability to connect progress/production signals to cost-to-complete outcomes
Executive-level communication skills, including preparation and delivery of steering committee materials (drivers, trends, risks, decisions required) and facilitation of cross-functional reviews
Preferred certifications: PMI-SP, PSP (AACE), CCP (AACE), PMP, CCM, or equivalent
Working Hours:
 On-Site, Full-Time, Exempt
Compensation Range:
 $180,000-$250,000 annually, depending on skills, experience and education.
What’s In It For You
Comprehensive health coverage (medical, dental, and vision)
Company-paid life and disability insurance
401(k) with day-one eligibility. We contribute dollar for dollar up to the first 3% of your contributions. Then we match 50% for the next 2% of your contributions.
Generous time off: 10 paid holidays and PTO starting at 15 days, growing up to 25
Access to Consertus Academy for continuous learning and development
How to Apply: 
If you’re passionate about this role we’d love to hear from you. Apply today!

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and identities, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected status.

title: Claims and Change Specialist
location: New York, New York, United States

Claims and Change Specialist

Your primary focus will be supporting claims analysis, contract administration, and change management activities associated with complex infrastructure construction projects, including contract research, change control, commercial management support, and coordination with project controls and construction management teams.

This is a long-term, full-time, on-site position located in New York, NY.

Responsibilities
 
may include, but are not limited to, the following:

Support the review of contractor notices, change requests, contract modifications, and related documentation through contract research and claims analysis.

Assist in evaluating entitlement considerations by reviewing contract requirements, technical documentation, project records, and applicable procedures.

Draft correspondence related to contract changes, requests for clarification, and change management activities for management review.

Prepare written summaries, analyses, and supporting documentation outlining contractual considerations, findings, and key project issues.

Support administration of the change control process in accordance with contract requirements, project procedures, and established change management practices.

Review and track change requests to help ensure compliance with contractual requirements, documentation standards, and established timelines.

Compile, maintain, and organize supporting documentation associated with change requests, including cost, schedule, technical, and project controls information.

Maintain accurate records of change orders, approvals, correspondence, negotiations, and supporting documentation within project tracking systems and change logs.

Coordinate with estimators, schedulers, project controls teams, construction management staff, contractors, and stakeholders to facilitate the collection and organization of information related to proposed changes.

Schedule and coordinate change management meetings, prepare meeting materials, and document action items, decisions, and follow-up activities.

Assist in the preparation and review of change proposal requests and related documentation.

Support change order negotiations by coordinating meetings, preparing materials, documenting discussions, and tracking outcomes.

Assist in ensuring change management activities comply with applicable contract requirements, procurement guidelines, project procedures, and audit requirements.

Organize and maintain project records to support internal and external audits related to contract compliance and change management activities.

Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.

Excellent organizational and analytical skills.

Collaborative mindset that fosters teamwork, trust, and positive relationships.

Natural curiosity, problem-solving abilities, and a passion for continuous improvement.

Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced project environment.

Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality, accountability, and professionalism.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction management, business, or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

2-5 years of experience supporting claims analysis, contract administration, change management, project controls, commercial management, or construction management activities on large infrastructure, transportation, transit, rail, aviation, or heavy civil construction projects.

Experience reviewing and interpreting construction contracts, specifications, change orders, contract modifications, notices, and other project documentation.

Experience supporting change management, contract administration, project controls, commercial management, or claims-related activities on design-build and/or alternative delivery projects.

Experience coordinating with estimators, schedulers, project controls teams, construction management teams, contractors, and project stakeholders.

Demonstrated experience in technical writing and project documentation.

Experience maintaining detailed project records, logs, correspondence, and supporting documentation.

Experience using Oracle Primavera Unifier or similar project controls, contract management, or change management software (Unifier preferred).

Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite/Office 365 (e.g., Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.).

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree in construction management, engineering, or business.

Experience supporting claims analysis, contract administration, change management, or commercial management on major transit, rail, tunnel, underground, or heavy civil infrastructure programs.

Experience supporting owner's representative, PMCM, program management, or construction management assignments.

Experience supporting design-build contracts exceeding $100M in construction value.

description:
About the Position

We’re seeking a 
Document Control Manager
 to support large, complex infrastructure programs, including highways, roads, bridges, transit (rail and bus), international airports, and water/wastewater projects delivered through both traditional and alternative delivery methods. Your primary focus will be leading document control operations, information governance, and enterprise document management initiatives that support program delivery, regulatory compliance, and organizational performance across major capital programs. This role will oversee document control personnel, establish and maintain program-wide standards, and support implementation and optimization of Electronic Document Management Systems (EDMS). The position requires close collaboration with project teams, consultants, contractors, quality management personnel, information technology staff, and executive leadership.

This is a long-term, full-time, on-site position located in Sacramento, CA.

title: Project Scheduler
description:
About the Position

We’re seeking a 
Project Scheduler
 to support a portfolio of major transit capital improvement projects. Your primary focus will be developing, maintaining, and analyzing project schedules for the owner's Project Controls team, supporting projects from planning and design through construction and closeout while helping ensure successful project delivery.

This is a long-term, full-time, on-site position located in San Jose, CA.

Responsibilities
 
may include, but are not limited to, the following:

Develop, maintain, and update master schedules, detailed project schedules, schedule forecasts, recovery schedules, and schedule reports for a portfolio of transportation capital projects.

Manage and regularly update schedules for approximately 80 to 100 active projects throughout planning, design, procurement, and construction.

Analyze project schedules to identify critical path activities, schedule risks, constraints, and opportunities for schedule improvement.

Review contractor baseline schedules, monthly schedule updates, recovery schedules, and schedule narratives for compliance with contract requirements.

Perform Time Impact Analysis (TIA) to evaluate schedule impacts associated with contract changes, delays, and change orders.

Coordinate closely with project managers, project controls staff, consultants, contractors, and stakeholders to maintain accurate project schedules and resolve schedule-related issues.

Integrate individual project schedules into larger program or master schedules to support program-level reporting and decision-making.

Support project controls activities involving schedule performance, cost controls, funding, earned value concepts, and project reporting.

Prepare schedule analyses, progress reports, executive dashboards, and other management reports that communicate project status, schedule performance, and forecasted outcomes.

Provide scheduling requirements and schedule specifications for inclusion in procurement and construction contract documents.

Evaluate contractor work sequencing, construction methods, productivity assumptions, and schedule logic to verify schedule reasonableness.

Support contract administration activities involving schedule analysis, change management, claims avoidance, and schedule documentation.

Coordinate with internal departments and external agencies to support project planning, delivery, and reporting requirements.

Attributes

Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.

Excellent organizational and analytical skills.

Collaborative mindset that fosters teamwork, trust, and positive relationships.

Natural curiosity, problem-solving abilities, and a passion for continuous improvement.

Ability to communicate schedule status, risks, and recommendations to both technical and executive stakeholders.

Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality, accountability, and professionalism.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction management, architecture, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

5+ years of experience developing, maintaining, and analyzing schedules for transit or other similar heavy civil infrastructure capital projects.

Strong knowledge of Critical Path Method (CPM) scheduling principles, schedule development, schedule analysis, and schedule forecasting.

Experience developing and reviewing contractor baseline schedules and monthly schedule updates.

Experience performing Time Impact Analysis (TIA) and evaluating schedule impacts associated with contract changes and delays.

Knowledge of earned value concepts and their application to project controls and schedule performance measurement.

Understanding of construction sequencing, construction means and methods, contract administration, and change management.

Experience coordinating with project managers, contractors, consultants, and owner representatives throughout project delivery.

Experience preparing schedule analyses, progress reports, executive reporting, and schedule performance metrics.

Proficiency with Oracle Primavera P6, Oracle Primavera Unifier, Microsoft Project, and other project controls software.

Proficiency with Microsoft Office 365 (e.g., Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.).

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction management, or architecture.

Planning & Scheduling Professional (PSP), Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified Cost Professional (CCP), or equivalent certification.

Experience supporting owner’s representative, program management, or construction management assignments.

Experience supporting design-build, CM/GC, or progressive design-build delivery methods.

Experience evaluating construction claims and schedule entitlement.

NDE Certs including VT, PT and MT

Intermediate understanding of Preheat/Post weld heat treatment of equipment and consumables.

Project Overview:
 
Bechtel is the licensing, engineering, procurement, and construction partner on TerraPower’s Natrium team. Selected by the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) for its Advanced Reactor Demonstration Program, Natrium is participating in a DOE initiative to re-establish U.S. leadership in nuclear energy that provides matching funding to industry to design and build an operational advanced reactor. TerraPower, a leading advanced generation technology company founded by former Microsoft CEO Bill Gates, will be deploying its 345 MWe sodium fast reactor (SFR), called Natrium. The Natrium plant features an advanced, cost-competitive reactor design that is safer, simpler, easier, and less costly to construct, less expensive to operate, and able to provide energy that is competitive with fossil fuels. It also features an innovative molten salt energy storage system designed to be complementary to solar and wind power by evening out the peaks and valleys in production when the sun is not shining or the wind is not blowing. With the reactor and energy storage output combined, the plant can produce more than 500 MWe of power. Other Team Natrium partners include GE Hitachi Nuclear Energy, Energy Northwest, PacifiCorp, and Duke Energy, along with support from a number of national laboratories and universities. This DOE Program has the potential to be the largest funding program for advanced nuclear power in U.S. history and will shape the future of nuclear energy for decades. We invite you to join our team for this historic and interesting opportunity! 
 
Job Summary:
 
In this role, you will lead, implement, and maintain global construction field welding programs and provide specialized welding engineering support. You will manage, inspect, and monitor the welding test lab, the rod room, the weld heat treatment program, and the laboratory quality plan. Your technical advice will help ensure defects, behaviors, and other issues are rectified prior to final inspection.

Support inspection activities using ITP and engineering drawings.
Provide specialized welding & inspection support for construction to ensure construction meets all code and Bechtel procedures including those found in the welding control manual.
Help manage the issue of weld filler materials for welders to meet Bechtel and Code requirements.
Help plan NDE activities of welding and coordinate with construction and Bechtel LFWE to support the overall construction schedule.
Demonstrate a personal commitment to safety.
Implementation of the project ES&H program and quality control program. 
Supporting the maintenance of calibrations as required for Pre/ PWHT equipment.
Working knowledge of our corporate Pre/PWHT Procedure ( PHT-2 ) and other welding procedures/standards.
Perform inspections and documentation of all welding, NDE, and Pre/ PWHT activities in progress on a continuing basis.
Prepares material requisitions and maintain inventory for all Pre/PWHT equipment and materials.
Coordinate work activities and training of direct hire Pre/ PWHT personnel.
Support the crafts in meeting quality requirements in order to maintain cost and schedule.
Coach lower-level engineers within the welding discipline to ensure employees’ and Bechtel's needs are accomplished to achieve project and Bechtel goals . 
Maintain weld inspection tracking system using Bechtel specific automation tools. Interface with the Lead Welding Engineer for direction of work assigned tasks.

Requires bachelor's degree (or international equivalent) and 8-10 years of relevant experience or 12-14 years of relevant work experience​

NDE Certs including PT, MT, and LT (Vac Box). Knowledge of AWS, API, NFPA, AWWA, ASTM and ASNT codes, specifications, and standards.
Must be certifiable by written examination to Bechtel's nondestructive examination requirements as NDE Level II Visual Examination.
Heavy industrial direct hire construction experience commensurate with the type of work to be undertaken.
Advanced knowledge and/or certifications in SMAW / GTAW / GMAW / FCAW.
Advanced knowledge of Piping Design Drawings / Specifications and TEAMWorks / WITS.
Intermediate understanding of Preheat/ Post weld heat treatment of equipment and consumables.
Knowledge of engineering and construction methods and processes customarily acquired over time through specialized instruction or practical experience.
Demonstrated ability to motivate team members effectively & positively in a collaborative team environment. 
Demonstrated ability to problem-solve in high pressure situations. Strong technical background and knowledge of all phases of LNG welding applications and methods, and non-destructive examination relating to LNG construction activities.
Experience on an LNG construction site along the U.S. Gulf Coast.
Understanding of applicable Bechtel work processes including Standard Work Process Procedures.
Knowledge and understanding of Bechtel's SWPP 4MP-T81-03701 Welding Program, 03708 Pre/ Post Weld Heat Treatment and 03705 Welding & NDE Documentation.
Familiarity with Bechtel Standard Applications (BSAPs) including Unifier, Aconex, DSCS, PTR, Agile, Navisworks, WITs, TEAMWorks, Arc Stryker, PipeFighter, and other automation tools which are used on Bechtel projects.

Headquartered in the U.S. with employees in various states, M&T also has colleagues in the United Kingdom, India, and other locations while we actively pursue exciting opportunities in other parts of the world. We are looking for talented people to join our team that are passionate about making a difference and contributing to historical projects that will have a lasting impact on society,
Job Summary:
 
LOTO Tagging Authority (TA) will report to the Lead LOTO Tagging Authority and is responsible for receiving and acting on requests to perform work on components or systems that are energized or have the potential to be energized. The TA will be responsible for energy isolation management in accordance with corporate and project specific procedures. Must be willing to work a flexible schedule if required.
Acting as the primary on-site LOTO Tagging Authority for commissioning, this position works closely with engineering, construction, operations, vendors, equipment suppliers, commissioning teams, and Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJs) to develop and execute comprehensive testing and validation programs. The role provides technical leadership throughout system turnover, integrated systems testing, regulatory inspections, and operational readiness activities to ensure all life safety systems are fully functional, code-compliant, documented, and ready for safe occupancy and operation.
•    Collaborate: Actively seeks out others’ opinions and input and is open-minded to their views. Challenges others appropriately and is also open to being challenged on their own views. 
•    Communicate: Is effective at adapting their communication style appropriately to their audience, providing context and using the right tone and level of information. 
•    Customer Focus: Prioritizes the customer needs and puts these at the forefront of all interactions. Ensures that others within their team maintain this same approach.
•    Deliver: Demonstrates making well thought out, timely decisions and prioritization that leads to successful outcomes. Includes the right people at the right time. 
•    Problem Solve: Accurately assesses a situation to find the best solution or way of working in order to resolve the issues. Is focused on creating a long term fix rather than a short-term solution.
•    Role Model: Contributes to the Bechtel culture by inspiring and motivating others through their positive approach and attitude. Comes to work determined to do a good job, for themselves and for their team. . 
#LI-AA1
Major Responsibilities:
 
Manage the integrated LOTO program on the Project coordinating between subcontractors, JV partners, and all other affected entities to deliver a safe and uniform program for the control of work and isolation of hazardous sources of energy.
Ensure the energy isolation program complies with SWPP's, STCP's, and Q4Safety. Use Q4Safety for electronic Energy Isolation Permits (EIP's).
Provide input and support to the Construction, Operations, and Commissioning teams, in piping, mechanical, and electrical isolations.
Identify isolation boundaries based on work scope and develop and issue EIP's.
Administer and manage the energy isolation program with strict enforcement and record keeping.
Perform other duties as directed in support of project activities.
Coordinate activities with other disciplines or areas and client representatives.
Maintain the training program and register on the project related to EIP's.
Procure material required to support the energy isolation management program.
Monitors the activities of subcontractors to ensure compliance with energy isolation.
Problem resolution and inspection of EIP's.
Monitor the installation of LOTO equipment such as Locks and Tags etc.
Work hours as required, including overtime, weekends, and holidays, as necessary to support the project.
Education and Experience Requirements:
 
Requires bachelor's degree (or international equivalent) and 8-10  years of relevant experience or 12-14 years of relevant work experience
Required Knowledge and Skills:
 
Construction experience assigned to a construction site.
Heavy industrial direct hire construction experience.
Experience in oil, gas, refinery, petrochemical, minerals processing, or power generating station construction.
Knowledge of engineering and construction methods and processes customarily acquired over time through specialized instruction or practical experience.
Demonstrated ability to motivate and lead team members effectively & positively in a collaborative team environment.
Demonstrated ability to problem-solve in high pressure situations.
Computer literate in word processing and spreadsheet and database applications.
Preferred: Experience on an LNG construction site especially along the U.S. Gulf Coast.
Preferred: Understanding of applicable Bechtel processes including Standard Work Process Procedures.
Preferred: Advanced knowledge of Project Bechtel Standard Applications (BSAPs) including Setroute, Unifier, Aconex, DSCS, PTR, Agile, Navisworks, and other automation tools which are used on Bechtel projects.
Experience managing technical services subcontracts.
Additional Information: 
Work requires the physical ability to conduct field inspections including but not limited to: extensive walking in and around a construction site often in high heat and high humidity conditions, climbing ladders, climbing scaffolding, working on elevated platforms, working on uneven surfaces, and working in small or confined spaces. 
Some lifting may be required. Must have the ability to walk into and out of the project (enter/egress). 
Must be able to use appropriate standard issued Personal Protection Equipment (PPE) required for each assigned task (i.e. harness, life vest, lift buckets, etc.).

title: Senior Principal Consultant
Senior Digital Consultant – Systems, Data & Analytics (Construction)
description:
Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.

Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.

We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.
Please visit our website: 
www.turnerandtownsend.com
 

We are seeking a strong 
Senior Digital Consultant
 with a strong focus on systems implementation, data, analytics, and information management to support major capital programs and portfolios across all sectors.
This role bridges project controls systems, information management, data analytics, and digital strategy, helping clients unlock value from data, improve delivery performance, and align ways of working with modern digital tools. You will lead a PMIS implementation and data strategy from requirements through configuration, implementation, adoption, and continuous improvement.
The role is client-facing, consultative, and delivery-oriented, with opportunities to shape strategy, lead technical delivery, support business development, and champion leading digital practices.
 
Key Responsibilities
Lead the development, validation, and translation of business and system requirements into practical digital solutions
Lead the configuration, implementation, and optimization of a PMIS systems for a large PMO focusing on cost, risk, schedule, and portfolio tools
Develop system configuration approaches, technical documentation, and implementation plans aligned to program objectives
Influence client ways of working to align operational processes with system capabilities and data models
Champion leading practice in digital systems configuration and integration across major capital programs
Capture and analyses client requirements to design digital strategies, data frameworks, and analytics approaches aligned to business outcomes
Support integration of project, cost, schedule, and asset data across the PMO into a series of reports
Design and implement dashboarding and reporting solutions (e.g. Power BI, Tableau) to enable insight-led decision-making
Provide technical training, coaching, and user adoption support to client teams
Contribute to high-quality documentation, presentations, and stakeholder communications
Provide technical input to business development, bid responses, and winning work
Support the continuous improvement of digital, data, and analytics capability across the business
Act as an ambassador for digital services, championing value-led digitization and innovation
Actively engage with emerging industry trends and technologies and embed learning into delivery
Technical Knowledge
Data and Information Management standards
Understanding of PMIS  Environments (e.g. Procore, Kahua, Unifier etc)
Dashboarding and analytics tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau)
Understanding of PMIS systems, cost, schedule, and portfolio management tools
Experience setting up and managing SharePoint, PowerApps, Power Automate and Power Query along with other collaborative digital workspaces

Skills & Experience
Strong understanding of digital systems and data-driven delivery within capital projects and asset management
Proven experience delivering client-facing digital or data-enabled change, from engagement start-up through implementation
Ability to clearly link digital solutions to client value, including cost, efficiency, assurance, and performance outcomes
Strong understanding of PMO / PMIS tools, methodologies, and governance
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, able to explain complex technical concepts clearly
High emotional intelligence with the confidence to challenge constructively and implement change
Qualifications
Degree or Masters in a STEM discipline (or equivalent)
Chartered or equivalent professional qualification with a professional institution or recognized body

The salary range for this full-time role is 
$110K-$170K
 per year. Ranges are determined by role and level and represent a good faith effort to provide a fair and equitable salary. title: Senior Project Controls Analyst
description:
Turner & Townsend
 is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries. 
Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.

We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

Turner & Townsend
 are seeking an ambitious 
Senior Project Controls Analyst
 to join our growing team. The ideal candidate has a proven track record of successful client delivery. This individual will assist in leading project controls services for major client accounts and will help with wider business initiatives if needed. 
This is a hybrid role, requiring onsite presence a few days per week to support client and team collaboration. Candidates must be based in or willing to commute to Chandler, AZ. 

 

 

Responsibilities: 
Develop and implement comprehensive project control strategies, processes, and procedures to optimize project performance and ensure adherence to timelines, budgets, and quality standards.  
Collaborate with project managers, engineers, and cross-functional teams to define project objectives, scope, deliverables, and KPIs.  
Create detailed project schedules using industry-standard project management software, considering critical path analysis, resource allocation, and dependencies.  
Monitor and analyze project progress against established baselines, identifying deviations, risks, and opportunities for improvement. Take proactive measures to mitigate risks and address issues promptly.  
Conduct regular project status meetings with stakeholders, providing accurate and timely reports on project performance, including schedule adherence, cost variance, earned value, and risk assessment.  
Provide expert advice and recommendations on project control best practices, including cost estimating, budgeting, forecasting, and earned value management.  
Develop and implement change management processes to assess and manage project scope changes, ensuring proper impact analysis, approval procedures, and documentation.  
Assist project teams in developing contingency plans, risk mitigation strategies, and recovery plans to address project challenges and ensure successful project outcomes.  
Support project managers in analyzing project data and generating reports to facilitate decision-making, identify trends, and provide insights into project performance.  
Train and mentor project team members on project control methodologies, tools, and techniques, fostering a culture of project control excellence within the organization.  
Stay up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in project controls, and proactively apply this knowledge to enhance project management processes.  
SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable. 
Project/Program specifications: 
Experience working with semiconductor and/or high-tech manufacturing clients. 
Experience with $1B+ Projects/Programs. 
Experience in Microsoft Power BI, SAP Financial & CPM, Hexagon Ecosys, Oracle Primavera Unifier 
Certifications in Power BI, PMP, Six Sigma, etc. 

Bachelor’s degree in construction management, cost management, quantity surveying, engineering, accounting or finance or field related to construction. 
Graduate degree in quantity surveying, cost management, construction management, or engineering is preferred. 
Minimum 10 years of relevant experience working in a project controls role in the construction industry. 
Proficiency in project management software (e.g., Primavera P6, Microsoft Project) and advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel for data analysis and reporting.  
Strong understanding of project control principles, methodologies, and tools, including schedule development, cost control, risk management, and performance measurement.  
Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex project data and provide meaningful insights and recommendations.  
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, stakeholders, and clients.  
Proven ability to work under pressure, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced project environment.  
Knowledge of regulatory requirements, industry standards, and compliance frameworks relevant to the project domain.  
Demonstrated leadership skills and the ability to influence and motivate project teams towards achieving project control objectives.

Turner & Townsend
 are seeking an ambitious 
Senior Project Controls Manager
 
to join our growing team. The ideal candidate has a proven track record of successful client delivery. This individual will assist in leading project controls services for major client accounts and will help with wider business initiatives if needed.
This is a hybrid role, requiring onsite presence a few days per week to support client and team collaboration. Candidates must be based in or willing to commute to Chandler, AZ.

Responsibilities
:
Develop and implement comprehensive project control strategies, processes, and procedures to optimize project performance and ensure adherence to timelines, budgets, and quality standards. 
Collaborate with project managers, engineers, and cross-functional teams to define project objectives, scope, deliverables, and KPIs. 
Create detailed project schedules using industry-standard project management software, considering critical path analysis, resource allocation, and dependencies. 
Monitor and analyze project progress against established baselines, identifying deviations, risks, and opportunities for improvement. Take proactive measures to mitigate risks and address issues promptly. 
Conduct regular project status meetings with stakeholders, providing accurate and timely reports on project performance, including schedule adherence, cost variance, earned value, and risk assessment. 
Provide expert advice and recommendations on project control best practices, including cost estimating, budgeting, forecasting, and earned value management. 
Develop and implement change management processes to assess and manage project scope changes, ensuring proper impact analysis, approval procedures, and documentation. 
Assist project teams in developing contingency plans, risk mitigation strategies, and recovery plans to address project challenges and ensure successful project outcomes. 
Support project managers in analyzing project data and generating reports to facilitate decision-making, identify trends, and provide insights into project performance. 
Train and mentor project team members on project control methodologies, tools, and techniques, fostering a culture of project control excellence within the organization. 
Stay up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in project controls, and proactively apply this knowledge to enhance project management processes. 
SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable.
Project/Program specifications:
Experience working with semiconductor and/or high-tech manufacturing clients.
Experience with $1B+ Projects/Programs.
Experience in Microsoft Power BI, SAP Financial & CPM, Hexagon Ecosys, Oracle Primavera Unifier
Certifications in Power BI, PMP, Six Sigma, etc.

Bachelor’s degree in construction management, cost management, quantity surveying, engineering, accounting or finance or field related to construction.
Graduate degree in quantity surveying, cost management, construction management, or engineering is preferred.
Minimum 10 years of relevant experience working in a project controls role in the construction industry.
Proficiency in project management software (e.g., Primavera P6, Microsoft Project) and advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel for data analysis and reporting. 
Strong understanding of project control principles, methodologies, and tools, including schedule development, cost control, risk management, and performance measurement. 
Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex project data and provide meaningful insights and recommendations. 
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, stakeholders, and clients. 
Proven ability to work under pressure, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced project environment. 
Knowledge of regulatory requirements, industry standards, and compliance frameworks relevant to the project domain. 
Demonstrated leadership skills and the ability to influence and motivate project teams towards achieving project control objectives.

description:

Turner & Townsend
 is seeking a 
Senior Construction Scheduler
 to join our Data Center team based in the U.S. and support the successful delivery of complex data center construction projects across the United States. This role will contribute to the planning, scheduling, and execution of mission-critical facilities, including new builds, expansions, and retrofit work.
The Senior Scheduler will collaborate with project teams, contractors, clients, and key stakeholders to develop, maintain, and analyze integrated project schedules throughout the project lifecycle. The ideal candidate will have expertise in scheduling, project controls, schedule risk analysis, and resource planning, with the ability to effectively support project performance, identify risks and opportunities, and deliver high-quality scheduling services in a client-facing environment.
Candidates for this role must be physically based in the United States and legally authorized to work in the U.S. Remote work is permitted only from within the United States; 
candidates located outside the U.S. cannot be considered
 
for
 remote 
employment.

Responsibilities:
Collaborate effectively with clients, project managers, design teams, contractors, subcontractors, and other stakeholders.
Develop, maintain, and analyze detailed project and program schedules using Primavera P6 within a multi-project environment.
Integrate schedule information from engineering, procurement, manufacturing, logistics, and construction teams into master program schedules.
Support implementation of project planning and scheduling standards, processes, and best practices across data center construction programs.
Partner with project and construction teams to maintain schedule integrity and ensure alignment with project objectives and milestones.
Monitor schedule performance, progress updates, and forecasting to identify potential delays, constraints, and recovery opportunities.
Coordinate and consolidate multiple sources of schedule data into integrated reporting platforms and program-level dashboards.
Prepare and deliver project status reports, schedule narratives, and executive-level presentations for internal and client stakeholders.
Generate and maintain milestone schedules and short-term look-ahead schedules to support project execution and decision-making.
Perform schedule risk assessments, critical path analysis, and what-if scenario modeling to evaluate project impacts.
Analyze schedule variances against baseline plans and provide recommendations for corrective actions and recovery strategies.
Evaluate schedule impacts related to scope changes, design revisions, procurement activities, and change orders.
Facilitate schedule review meetings and work closely with project teams to proactively resolve scheduling challenges.
Support project controls reporting and governance requirements, including compliance with applicable company and client standards.
SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable. 

 
Experience working in mission critical environments is preferred including commissioning activities.
Construction experience- i.e. “boots on the ground.” This is site-level construction experience who knows the construction process.
Understanding of best practice relating to the delivery of a construction program is required.
Extensive experience creating and managing large-scale construction schedules in Primavera P6.
A background in Project Controls is beneficial.
Familiarity with construction drawings, specifications and construction sequencing is required.

 is seeking an experienced 
Director of Project Controls
 to lead cost, schedule, and risk management for a large-scale data center construction program in

, while supporting major client accounts and broader business initiatives. This is a senior leadership role responsible for establishing and overseeing robust project controls processes, ensuring accurate forecasting, reporting, and governance across all phases of delivery.
The Director will partner with project leadership, contractors, and stakeholders to maintain transparency, mitigate risks, and drive performance against budget and schedule targets. You will lead project controls teams, ensure best practices are implemented, and act as a trusted advisor to clients.

Establish and execute the strategic direction for project controls, including cost, schedule, and risk management, for a large-scale data center program.

Lead development and integration of detailed CPM schedules (Primavera P6/MS Project) across design, procurement, construction, and commissioning; monitor critical path and implement recovery plans.
Define and manage risk registers; lead risk workshops, establish mitigation strategies, and coordinate contingency planning, including Monte Carlo analyses.
Manage change control processes, including evaluation of scope changes, impact analysis, and cost reduction initiatives.
Prepare executive-level dashboards, gateway documentation, and reports for senior leadership, highlighting performance, risks, and corrective actions.
Ensure alignment on cost and schedule objectives through collaboration with project managers, finance teams, and contractors; support client reporting and governance meetings.
Drive data integrity and reporting accuracy across all phases; utilize project controls tools and platforms (e.g., Primavera P6, MS Project, cost systems).
Develop and maintain protocols for performance measurement, forecasting, trending, and progress reporting against project baselines.
Lead and mentor a high-performing project controls team; provide clear direction, conduct performance reviews, and foster a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
Motivate the team through regular meetings, clear goals, and quality assurance of deliverables; ensure integration of intake, cost, and scheduling processes for end-to-end project controls.
Act as a key liaison with internal and external stakeholders; review implementation plans, claims resolution recommendations, and recovery strategies.
Support business initiatives by identifying opportunities for process improvement, knowledge sharing, and integration of best practices across projects.

12+ years of experience in project controls, cost management, and scheduling for large-scale construction programs (data center or mission-critical preferred), including 2+ years leading high-performing project controls teams in a consulting environment.
Proven ability to manage complex budgets, schedules, and risk for multi-million-dollar projects; experience establishing and monitoring baselines and performance metrics.
Expertise in cost forecasting, earned value management (EVM), risk analysis, and change management; strong knowledge of multiple contract delivery methods.
Demonstrated success in implementing and managing integrated project controls systems, including financial and scheduling controls, for major capital projects.
Proficiency in Primavera P6, MS Project, and cost management systems; advanced Excel skills for data analysis and reporting.
Professional certifications such as CCP, PSP, PMP, or equivalent highly desirable.
Excellent analytical, leadership, and communication skills; ability to interpret complex data, influence stakeholders, and drive performance.
Knowledge of industry standards, regulatory requirements, and compliance frameworks relevant to large-scale construction programs.

Monitor progress of CQV tasks, identify potential delays, and proactively implement mitigation strategies to keep projects on track.
Utilize scheduling tools such as Primavera P6 or MS Project to create and maintain accurate schedules and reports.
Support resource planning and allocation for CQV activities across multiple concurrent projects.
Ensure compliance with GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) and other regulatory standards throughout the CQV lifecycle.
Provide regular updates and reports to project stakeholders, highlighting key risks, dependencies, and progress metrics.

Expertise using Primavera P6.  
Excellent communication skills.

Effectively work with Stakeholders, Clients, Contractors and Sub Contractors on a daily basis.

Ensure that schedule related data from vendors, suppliers, engineering and construction contractors of actual projects is provided as feedback into the planning and scheduling systems.

Perform probabilistic analysis on integrated schedules and contractor schedules.
Actively monitor and communicate any possible project issues that could delay the schedule.
Conduct the required project schedule analysis, critical path analysis and schedule risk analysis for the project as a whole.

Construction experience- i.e. “boots on the ground.” This is site-level construction experience who knows the construction process.

Extensive experience creating and managing large-scale construction schedules in Primavera P6.
A background in Project Controls is beneficial.
Familiarity with construction drawings, specifications and construction sequencing is required.
Being able to work independently is crucial.
Capable of producing detailed concept level schedules from limited project information. Identifying major phases through that timeline and be able to determine and discuss dependencies.
Working closely with various disciplines in project teams to ensure the accuracy and completeness of the schedules produced without compromising your independence as a scheduler so you are in a position to advise project management on issues requiring judgment.
Knowledge of system start-up sequences and major dependencies.
Able to convert data into Tableau reports and graphics.
Excellent collaboration and communication skills are required.

description:

Project Controls Specialist 
to overseeing project controls functions for high-quality infrastructure projects. The ideal candidate will lead and manage the full suite of project controls functions, including scheduling, cost control, risk and change management, forecasting, and reporting. This role partners closely with Project Managers to ensure that performance data is accurate, timely, and actionable, while supervising a team of project control specialists and analysts.
Responsibilities:
Lead project budgeting, cost baseline development, and approval processes.
Generate periodic cost forecasts and develop trend analyses to support proactive decision-making.
Prepare comprehensive project and program performance reports, dashboards, and trend analyses.
Communicate deviations, forecasts, risks, and recommended actions effectively to senior management and program leadership.
Ensure consistency and accuracy of all project controls data, reports, and documentation.
Supervise, mentor, and develop a team of project controls staff, including schedulers, cost analysts, and document control specialists.
Collaborate with Project Managers, Contracts Administration, and Finance teams to ensure alignment and data integrity.
Champion best practices, continuous improvement, lessons learned, and knowledge sharing within the project controls discipline.
Support standardization of tools, templates, and procedures to improve reporting efficiency and accuracy across the GEC program.
Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Business, Finance, or related field. Professional certifications preferred (PMP, CCP, EVMP, or similar).
3+ years of experience in project controls or project controls management for large infrastructure, transportation, or civil works projects.
Experience in public sector environments; DOT/highway project experience is a plus.
Proficiency with scheduling tools (e.g., Primavera P6, Microsoft Project) and cost control software (e.g., SAP, Deltek, Unifier, Costpoint).
Strong analytical skills, financial acumen, trend analysis, forecasting, and variance analysis.
Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, with ability to present to senior leadership.
Ability to coordinate and interface with multiple internal and external stakeholders (project teams, consultants, contractors, regulatory agencies).
Attention to detail, organizational aptitude, process orientation, and high integrity.

title: Project Controls Specialist
description:
STV is seeking a Project Controls Specialist to join our Project Controls department at our Dallas, TX office, to support cost, schedule, and performance management on complex infrastructure and capital projects.

Construction project performance metrics, performance analysis, dashboards, and progress reports.

Experience performing or leading project controls for mid ($50M+) to large ($500M+) capital construction projects, programs, and/or portfolios.

Capital construction controls experience in the rail industry.

Job Summary
 
The Senior Manager, Work Planning is responsible for providing leadership, direction, and oversight for work group planning in the New York Division of the Northeast Corridor.  This position leads the New York regional team of Amtrak’s IPRC group (Implementation, Planning, & Resource Coordination) within the Capital Delivery Department.

 

The IPRC New York regional team is responsible for the intricate planning and coordination process for multi-discipline (Track, Electric Traction, Communications & Signals, and Structures) track outages, power outages, and labor forecasting for major in-house maintenance and construction, major Capital Delivery projects, and third-party projects in the New York Division of the Northeast Corridor.
Essential Functions
 

Lead a team of technical managers, responsible for outage planning & coordination and forecasting of Amtrak labor demand in the New York Division.

Lead and manage effective coordinated planning of project-driven outages (track usage and AC/DC power) for in-house IMCS, Capital Delivery, and third-party projects on the NYD over the NEC, and ensure they are incorporated into the appropriate Seasonal Service Plan(s).

Lead the development of Amtrak labor support forecasts (in-house direct labor and/or support of third-party construction) for Life of Project.

Collaborate with peers in other groups (Project Management, Construction Management, Transportation, Service Planning, Engineering System Offices, Capital Project Teams, Division Maintenance, and System Production) to develop comprehensive outage and labor support plans based on projected Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and Annual Grants (AG).

Lead quarterly regional resource reviews with Senior Leadership.

Implement labor resource allocation guidelines in coordination with relevant internal departments and ensure adherence to guidelines in labor resource allocation decisions.

Analyze challenges, problems, and process breakdowns to ensure that lessons learned are used to improve work planning and project delivery practices; identify efficiencies and present recommended improvement opportunities to various levels of management.

Minimum Qualifications
 

Bachelor’s Degree (in Engineering, Transportation, Construction Management, or closely related field) required OR equivalent combination of training, education and relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a degree. Plus,

9 years of relevant experience required

11+ years of relevant experience preferred

Preferred Qualifications
 
Fundamental understanding of:

Theories, principles, and practices of passenger railroad systems design, construction, operations, and maintenance.

Railroad infrastructure and components, including track, structures, communications, signals, and electric traction systems.

Amtrak-maintained territory and operation.

Collective Bargaining Agreements for labor work forces.

Experience with and understanding of key stakeholders:

U.S. Department of Transportation / Federal Railroad Administration

Commuter railroads and freight carriers

Familiarity with Primavera P6 scheduling software.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
 
Fundamental knowledge and understanding of:

Railroad operations and/or maintenance and construction of railroad infrastructure.

Working knowledge of the Northeast corridor and connecting commuter/freight routes.

description:
Your success is a train ride away!

As we move America’s workforce toward the future, Amtrak connects businesses and communities across the country. We employ more than 20,000 diverse, energetic professionals in a variety of career fields throughout the United States. The safety of our passengers, our employees, the public and our operating environment is our priority, and the success of our railroad is due to our employees.

 

Are you ready to join our team?

Our values of ‘Do the Right Thing, Excel Together and Put Customers First’ are at the heart of what matters most to us, and our Core Capabilities, ‘Building Trust, Accountability, Effective Communication, Customer Focus, and Proactive Safety & Security’ are what every employee needs to know and do to be most impactful at Amtrak. By living the Amtrak values, focusing on our capabilities, and actively embracing and fostering diverse ideas, backgrounds, and perspectives, together we will honor our past and make Amtrak a company of the future.

 
Job Summary
 
The Project Controls Manager working in the Capital Delivery (CAPD) central organization will work with Delivery Arms Project Teams in CAPD coaching and advising on Cost Engineering, Change Management and other project controls procedures and guidelines.  The Project Controls Manager will apply Project Controls tools, data analytics, systems and work processes to ensure projects are compliant with Amtrak procedures, processes and guidelines.  Individuals in this role will work with the Director Project Controls in drafting and/or updating department policies or procedures, supporting continuous improvement efforts, providing feedback, coaching, and/or mentoring project teams and project control practitioners, to assist with compliance with company and CAPD standards.     
Essential Functions
 

Advises and coaches on all aspects of Cost Engineering, Change Management and other project controls procedures, processes, guidelines, and utilization of Amtrak’s Project Management Information System to record required project status updates.

Supports Project Teams in understanding the Change Management process including creating Project Change Request (PCR), utilizing Project Contingency, Change Control Board (CCB) and creating funding request/reprogramming.  Reviewing quality of PCR to ensure all steps are documented and in adherence with Amtrak and CAPD standards.

Works with the Director Project Control on the update, development, preparation, and maintenance of CAPD procedures and guidelines for cost control, cost engineering, contingency utilization, and earned value management, utilizing best practices, and requirements, and incorporating standards and techniques from recognized organizations such as AACE and PMI.

Develops and/or utilizes reporting mechanisms (forecast, schedules, project risks, and other indicators) on project performance against plan, to ensure a cohesive picture of the project or portfolio performance.

Advises and trains project teams and project controls practitioners on how to accurately complete the monthly forecast and other regular reporting. Reviews the accuracy of reports and provides feedback on issues or inconsistencies. 

Works with project teams to ensure timely completion of monthly Project Overall Status Reporting (POSR) and performs quality checks and audits on project data submitted.

Supports the Fiscal Year Annual Operating Plan process and works with project teams reviewing timelines and requirements to ensure cost data integrity, and alignment of the projects Annual, 5-year plan and Life of Project financials.

Advises and assists project teams on the use of project management systems and tools, Power BI dashboard, policies, procedures and guidelines and the SharePoint site.

Experience using Primavera P6 or other scheduling system.

Experience utilizing Earned Value Management. Experience using PowerBI or Power Apps to create data applications.

Experience implementing project control software and tools.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
 

Knowledge of principles and practices of project management through all phases of the project lifecycle.

Familiarity with business processes, techniques, and procedures related to project cost engineering/cost management and cost estimation in large and/or complex capital construction projects.

Experience writing policies, procedures, guidelines, technical manuals, or training materials.

Knowledge of planning and forecasting tools, methods, techniques, standards, and best practices, including resource management, progress measurement, and earned value management for construction or engineering projects.

Understanding of project financial reporting, forecasting, analysis, and monitoring capital project/program / portfolio funding and/or budget. 

Understanding construction project performance metrics, performance analysis, dashboards, and progress reports. 

Ability to research, analyze, evaluate performance gaps, and implement new business processes, tools, methods, and techniques to improve performance or output. 

Experience with establishing standard practices and business processes pertaining to project control’s function, including drafting or updating technical specifications, procedures, or policies.

Able to facilitate training on the job or by preparation and delivery of group instructional sessions.

Experience using a Project Management Information System PMIS.

Supports or leads efforts to develop and implement initiatives for improvement of business processes and tools, in coordination with other internal departments. 

Creates workflow diagrams, SOPs, procedures, training materials, guidelines, and other similar products to support the business functions.

May be assigned as the Project Controls Subject Matter Expert or Manager on a project.

Performs other related duties in support of Capital Delivery.

Minimum Qualifications
 

Bachelor’s Degree required OR equivalent combination of training, education and relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a degree. Plus,

7 years of prior relevant experience required. 

Advanced knowledge and experience with project cost controls and change management functions.

Intermediate knowledge of other functions. including scheduling, estimating, and quality control.

Preferred Qualifications
 

Plus 9 years of relevant work experience.

Project Management Institute (PMI) or Associate for the Advancement of Cost Engineering AACE Certification.

Capital construction controls experience in the rail industry, transportation industry, or similar.

Experience with developing processes, procedures, guidelines, tools and training in a PMO or center of excellence.

Understands or can quickly learn various Amtrak systems, such as PMIS, SAP, Ariba on Demand, and Maximo.

Demonstrated Intermediate to Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills.

Skill in communicating complex information clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing, across all levels.

Effectively working diplomatically across teams with varying degrees of project management experience. 

Knowledge of principles and practices of project management through all phases of the project lifecycle.

Understanding of project financial reporting, forecasting, analysis, and monitoring capital project/program/portfolio funding and/or budget.

Ability to analyze technical information and communicate to a nontechnical audience.

Experience or training working in a PMIS project management information system.

Advanced experience with Change Management processes.

Work Environment
 

Office building environment.

Work in cubicle setting; stand, sit, bend, twist, use file drawers.

Sit at computer to complete assignments, projects, and majority of tasks.

Ability to be flexible with changing priorities and work under pressure.

Occasional travel as needed.

Provides specialized welding engineering support for construction to ensure construction meets all code, client/engineering specifications and Bechtel procedures and standards.

Manages and monitors the welding test lab to ensure high quality welders are being tested and hired.

Manages issues and maintains welder qualifications and welder stamps.
Performs field inspections of welding work, and advises on rectification of quality behaviors and defects prior to final inspection

NDE Certs including VT, PT, MT and RT.
Knowledge of AWS, API, NFPA, AWWA, ASTM and ASNT codes, specifications, and standards.
Heavy industrial direct hire construction experience commensurate with the type of work to be undertaken.
Advanced knowledge and/or certifications in SMAW / GTAW / GMAW / FCAW.
Advanced understanding of Preheat/Post weld heat treatment of equipment and consumables.
Knowledge of engineering and construction methods and processes customarily acquired over time through specialized instruction or practical experience.
Demonstrated ability to motivate team members effectively & positively in a collaborative team environment.
Demonstrated ability to problem-solve in high pressure situations.
Experience on an HRSG / Power Boiler construction projects.
Strong technical background and knowledge of all phases of welding applications, and non-destructive examination relating to construction activities.
Understanding of applicable Bechtel work processes including Standard Work Process Procedures.
Advanced knowledge of Piping Design Drawings/Specifications and Teamwork’s/WITS.
Must be certifiable by written examination to Bechtel's nondestructive examination requirements as NDE Level II Visual and Radiographic Examination.
Knowledge and understanding of Bechtel's SWPP 4MP-T81-03701 Welding Program, 03708 Pre/Post Weld Heat Treatment and 03705 Welding & NDE Documentation.
Familiarity with Bechtel Standard Applications (BSAPs) including Unifier, Aconex, DSCS, PTR, Agile, Navisworks, WITs, Teamwork’s, Arc Stryker, Pipe Fighter, and other automation tools which are used on Bechtel projects.

title: Senior Cost Engineering Specialist
description:
STV is seeking a 
Senior Cost Engineering Specialist
 to join our growing Project Controls team in 
Dallas, Texas
. This role is ideal for an experienced cost engineering professional who excels at providing cost management, forecasting, earned value analysis, change management, and financial performance oversight for complex infrastructure, transportation, and capital improvement programs.
The Senior Cost Engineering Specialist serves as a trusted advisor to project managers, clients, and project leadership teams by providing accurate and timely cost analysis that supports informed decision-making and successful project delivery. The ideal candidate brings strong analytical skills, advanced cost management expertise, and the ability to independently lead cost engineering efforts across multiple projects.
Key Responsibilities
Cost Management & Forecasting
Lead development, maintenance, and analysis of project budgets, cost reports, cash flow forecasts, and Estimate at Completion (EAC) calculations.
Monitor project expenditures, commitments, accruals, and forecasts to ensure alignment with approved budgets.
Perform detailed cost variance, trend, and productivity analyses to identify project risks and opportunities.
Develop and maintain cost breakdown structures (CBS) and reporting frameworks.
Support project teams with financial planning, budget controls, and forecasting processes.
Earned Value Management & Performance Reporting
Implement and maintain Earned Value Management (EVM) processes and methodologies.
Analyze Cost Performance Index (CPI), Schedule Performance Index (SPI), and other key project performance indicators.
Develop dashboards and executive-level reporting packages that communicate project performance, trends, and financial health.
Provide recommendations to mitigate cost overruns and improve project performance.
Change Management & Cost Impact Analysis
Evaluate change orders, contract modifications, and scope changes for financial impacts.
Perform detailed cost impact assessments and support negotiations with clients, contractors, and project stakeholders.
Maintain change management logs and ensure proper documentation and approval workflows.
Support claims avoidance and dispute resolution through detailed cost analysis and documentation.
Risk Analysis & Financial Planning
Identify project cost risks and opportunities throughout the project lifecycle.
Support quantitative risk assessments and contingency evaluations.
Develop scenario analyses and forecasting models to evaluate alternative project outcomes.
Collaborate with project controls, scheduling, and risk management teams to establish integrated project performance assessments.
Client Engagement & Leadership
Serve as the primary cost engineering resource on assigned projects and programs.
Present project financial performance updates to internal leadership and external clients.
Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior cost engineers and project controls professionals.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, standards development, and best practices across the Project Controls organization.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Project Controls, or a related discipline.
8–12+ years of progressive experience
 in cost engineering, project controls, construction management, or program controls.
Demonstrated experience supporting large transportation, infrastructure, aviation, transit, facilities, energy, or capital improvement programs.
Advanced experience with:
Cost forecasting
Budget management
Earned Value Management (EVM)
Cost variance analysis
Change management
Financial performance reporting
Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including advanced financial analysis and reporting capabilities.
Excellent communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to independently manage multiple assignments in a fast-paced environment.

AACE International certifications such as:
Certified Cost Professional (CCP)
Earned Value Professional (EVP)
Planning & Scheduling Professional (PSP)
Experience with PMIS platforms such as:
e-Builder
Kahua
Oracle Primavera Unifier
Deltek Cobra
EcoSys
Experience supporting public-sector and transportation clients.
Familiarity with Primavera P6 and schedule-cost integration methodologies.
Experience supporting projects valued at $100M+.
