Project Overview:
 
Bechtel’s Manufacturing and Technology (M&T) Business Unit is designing, building and commissioning a semiconductor fab in Clay, NY. M&T is an exciting and growing business unit that serves customers in the semiconductor, datacenter, life sciences, and electric vehicle markets. M&T strives to exceed our customer objectives through utilizing our agility, innovative technologies, and world class talent. M&T solves the industry's toughest challenges, building both our company and the world for the future. Headquartered in Reston, Virginia, the M&T global business unit also includes colleagues working in Arizona, Ohio, Texas, India, and additional project locations around the world. 
Job Summary:
 
In this role, you will lead, implement, and maintain global construction field welding programs and provide specialized welding engineering support. You will manage, inspect, and monitor the welding test lab, the rod room, the weld heat treatment program, and the laboratory quality plan. Your technical advice will help ensure defects, behaviors, and other issues are rectified prior to final inspection. 
#LI-BH1
Major Responsibilities:
 
Supports the Project Field Engineer and the Lead Field Welding engineer in implementing the site welding program on small projects  
Implements and maintains Bechtel Field Welding program for all welding operations.  
Provides technical assistance to field superintendents and crafts.  
Ensures that all supervision and craft personnel involved in welding operations are educated and aware of applicable code and project requirements.  
Additional Requirements for Post Weld Heat Treatment Coordinator 
Coordinates work activities of subcontractor and direct-hire pre/ PWHT personnel.  
Possesses working knowledge of Bechtel's corporate pre/PWHT procedure (PHT-2) and other welding procedures / standards.  
Supports the crafts in meeting cost and schedules. 
Education and Experience Requirements:
 
Requires bachelor's degree (or international equivalent) and 8-10 years of relevant experience or 12-14 years of relevant work experience​
Required Knowledge and Skills:
 
A minimum 5 years of experience in direct hire welding and NDE on Semi-conductor projects.
Knowledge of AWS, API, NFPA, AWWA, ASTM and ASNT codes, specifications, and standards.
Heavy industrial direct hire construction experience commensurate with the type of work to be undertaken.
Advanced knowledge and/or certifications in SMAW / GTAW / GMAW / FCAW.
Intermediate understanding of Preheat/Post weld heat treatment of equipment and consumables.
Knowledge of engineering and construction methods and processes customarily acquired over time through specialized instruction or practical experience.
Demonstrated ability to motivate team members effectively & positively in a collaborative team environment.
Demonstrated ability to problem-solve in high pressure situations.
Strong technical background and knowledge of all phases of construction welding applications and methods, and non-destructive examination relating to construction activities.
Understanding of applicable Bechtel work processes including Standard Work Process Procedures.
Advanced knowledge of Piping Design Drawings/Specifications and Teamwork’s/WITS.
Must be certifiable by written examination to Bechtel's nondestructive examination requirements as NDE Level II Visual Examination.
Knowledge and understanding of Bechtel's SWPP 4MP-T81-03701 Welding Program, 03708 Pre/Post Weld Heat Treatment and 03705 Welding & NDE Documentation.
Familiarity with Bechtel Standard Applications (BSAPs) including Unifier, Aconex, DSCS, PTR, Agile, Navisworks, WITs, Teamwork’s, Arc Stryker, Pipe Fighter, and other automation tools which are used on Bechtel projects. 
Additional Information:
 
Work includes field inspections and the physical ability to conduct field inspections which require the following activities: extensive walking in and around a construction site, climbing ladders, climbing scaffolding, working on elevated platforms, working on uneven surfaces and working in small or confined spaces.  Some lifting may be required. Must have the ability to walk into and out of the project (enter/egress).  Must be able to use appropriate standard issued Personal Protection Equipment (PPE) required for each assigned task (i.e. harness, life vest, lift buckets, etc.). Must be willing to work a flexible schedule if required that may include but not limited to nightshift or split shift.

title: Senior Digital Consultant – Systems, Data & Analytics (Construction)
description:
Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.

Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.

We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

Please visit our website: 
www.turnerandtownsend.com
 

We are seeking a strong 
Senior Digital Consultant
 with a strong focus on systems implementation, data, analytics, and information management to support major capital programs and portfolios across all sectors.
This role bridges project controls systems, information management, data analytics, and digital strategy, helping clients unlock value from data, improve delivery performance, and align ways of working with modern digital tools. You will lead a PMIS implementation and data strategy from requirements through configuration, implementation, adoption, and continuous improvement.
The role is client-facing, consultative, and delivery-oriented, with opportunities to shape strategy, lead technical delivery, support business development, and champion leading digital practices.
 
Key Responsibilities
Lead the development, validation, and translation of business and system requirements into practical digital solutions
Lead the configuration, implementation, and optimization of a PMIS systems for a large PMO focusing on cost, risk, schedule, and portfolio tools
Develop system configuration approaches, technical documentation, and implementation plans aligned to program objectives
Influence client ways of working to align operational processes with system capabilities and data models
Champion leading practice in digital systems configuration and integration across major capital programs
Capture and analyses client requirements to design digital strategies, data frameworks, and analytics approaches aligned to business outcomes
Support integration of project, cost, schedule, and asset data across the PMO into a series of reports
Design and implement dashboarding and reporting solutions (e.g. Power BI, Tableau) to enable insight-led decision-making
Provide technical training, coaching, and user adoption support to client teams
Contribute to high-quality documentation, presentations, and stakeholder communications
Provide technical input to business development, bid responses, and winning work
Support the continuous improvement of digital, data, and analytics capability across the business
Act as an ambassador for digital services, championing value-led digitization and innovation
Actively engage with emerging industry trends and technologies and embed learning into delivery
Technical Knowledge
Data and Information Management standards
Understanding of PMIS  Environments (e.g. Procore, Kahua, Unifier etc)
Dashboarding and analytics tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau)
Understanding of PMIS systems, cost, schedule, and portfolio management tools
Experience setting up and managing SharePoint, PowerApps, Power Automate and Power Query along with other collaborative digital workspaces

Skills & Experience
Strong understanding of digital systems and data-driven delivery within capital projects and asset management
Proven experience delivering client-facing digital or data-enabled change, from engagement start-up through implementation
Ability to clearly link digital solutions to client value, including cost, efficiency, assurance, and performance outcomes
Strong understanding of PMO / PMIS tools, methodologies, and governance
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, able to explain complex technical concepts clearly
High emotional intelligence with the confidence to challenge constructively and implement change
Qualifications
Degree or Masters in a STEM discipline (or equivalent)
Chartered or equivalent professional qualification with a professional institution or recognized body

The salary range for this full-time role is 
$110K - $170K
 per year. Ranges are determined by role and level and represent a good faith effort to provide a fair and equitable salary. This range is a reflection of base salary only, not of a total compensation package.  Please note Turner & Townsend reserves the right to pay more or less than the posted range, depending on candidate’s experience and qualifications. 
*On-site presence and requirements may change depending on our client's needs
Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.
We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance. 
Turner & Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.
Please find out more about us at 
www.turnerandtownsend.com/

Instagram

title: P6 Scheduler
description:
Consertus is a global capital program management and advisory firm that combines deep human expertise with advanced digital tools to deliver smarter, faster, and more sustainable outcomes. Headquartered in Miami, Florida, and supported by a team of more than 1,000 professionals worldwide, we help clients plan, execute, and optimize large-scale capital programs.
Our integrated services span digital, advisory, and delivery, empowering organizations to navigate complexity, manage risk, and achieve strategic goals in sectors including aviation, transportation, transit, water, healthcare, energy, education, government, commercial, life sciences, and technology.
At Consertus, we celebrate individual strengths, foster strong relationships, and promote flexibility in how and where we work. Join us to grow your career, develop your skills, and make a lasting impact as we transform how the world is built.
Discover how Consertus is driving transformative change for our clients, our people, and the communities we serve at 
www.consertus.com
  
About this Role:
Consertus is seeking a 
P6 Scheduler
 with 3-7 years of utilities industry experience to support PG&E's Transmission Line, and Substation major projects throughout its service territory. This role will provide project controls support for medium- to high-complexity electric transmission and distribution projects, including transmission line, substation, and electric generation interconnection scopes. The successful candidate will manage schedule and cost information, collaborate closely with project teams, and deliver accurate forecasts, reporting, and project controls documentation.
Key Responsibilities:
Project Scheduling and Forecasting
Create and maintain resource-loaded project schedules in Primavera P6, partnering with Project Managers to status schedules and ensure accurate forecasts, reporting, and baselines.
Develop and update schedules that forecast labor resources, contracts, and materials through the full project lifecycle, including support for monthly baseline-setting activities.
Attend project site visits as required to collect actual progress and build schedule detail in coordination with engineering and construction teams.
Cost, Budget, and Contract Support
Support the management of project scope, schedule, and cost, including required budget forecasting in PG&E systems.
Coordinate contract payment schedules, contractor progress reporting, accruals, executed contracts, change orders, and related schedule updates.
Create and update project documentation, including estimates, budget requests, scope changes, baseline requests, and official project records.
Project Controls Reporting and Governance
Analyze project controls trends, dashboard metrics, schedule variances, risk registers, construction readiness, and other performance information; prepare and present timely updates.
Prepare financial, scheduling, forecast, and status reports in accordance with PG&E standards, procedures, and reporting requirements.
Evaluate project data for governance compliance, data quality, and performance against key indicators such as float, trend analysis, executability, Contract Forecast Management, order management, and SOX compliance.
Collaboration and Project Delivery
Participate in staff, resource, and project meetings and provide updated schedules, resource information, and reports as required.
Interface with PG&E staff, Project Managers, contractors, engineering teams, and construction teams to support project execution and respond to ad hoc requests.
Perform work in accordance with PG&E specifications, procedures, standards, and applicable site-safety requirements.
Minimum Qualifications
3-7 years of project controls, scheduling, or related experience within the utilities industry.
Strong hands-on experience with Primavera P6, including schedule development, updates, forecasting, and baseline management.
Demonstrated experience managing both cost and schedule information for capital projects.
Experience developing and maintaining resource-loaded schedules and analyzing schedule performance and variances.
Strong analytical, reporting, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across project teams.
Willingness to learn, adapt to evolving requirements, and take on new challenges.
Preferred Qualifications 
Experience supporting electric transmission and distribution projects, including transmission line, substation, or generation interconnection scopes.
Familiarity with PG&E project controls processes, procedures, systems, or reporting standards.
Experience with project controls tools and platforms such as SAP, Unifier, ProjectWise, or comparable systems.
Experience supporting contract forecasts, payment schedules, accruals, change orders, risk registers, and construction readiness reporting.
Ability to collaborate directly with engineering and construction teams and participate in project site visits as needed.
Working Hours & Location: 
Full-time role with standard business hours and occasional additional hours based on project deadlines or business needs.
The position is currently remote with occasional in-person meetings. Beginning in September, the selected candidate will be expected to work from PG&E's Oakland office two days per week.
Candidates located in the San Francisco Bay Area are strongly preferred. Occasional travel or project site visits within PG&E's service territory may be required.
Compensation Range: 
$128,960 - $139,360 annually
What’s In It for You: 
Comprehensive Health Coverage (medical, dental, vision)
Optional benefits like pet insurance, legal insurance and supplemental health plans
401(k) with day-one eligibility. You’ll get a 100% match on the first 3% of your eligible compensation and 50% match on contributions between 3% and 5% of your pay.
Generous time off: 10 paid holidays, and PTO starting at 15 days, growing to up to 25 days
Access to Consertus Academy for continuous learning and development
How to Apply: 
If you are a P6 Scheduler interested in supporting complex utility capital projects in the Bay Area, we’d like to hear from you. Please apply through the Consertus Careers portal and upload your most recent resume (PDF preferred).
Equal Employment Opportunity Statement:
Consertus is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and identities, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected status.

Understanding of applicable Bechtel work processes including Standard Work Process Procedures.

Relocation Authorized: National/International - Family
 
Telework Type: Part-Time Telework
 
Work Location: Houston, TX

Since 1898, we have helped customers complete more than 25,000 projects in 160 countries on all seven continents that have created jobs, grown economies, improved the resiliency of the world's infrastructure, increased access to energy, resources, and vital services, and made the world a safer, cleaner place.

Project Overview:
 
Phase 1 of the latest SPL expansion is expected to consist of one large-scale train, Train 7, and one boil-off gas reliquefaction unit, along with supporting infrastructure and tie-ins to the existing facility. SPL is the first and largest LNG production and export complex in the U.S. Lower 48. It produced and shipped its first LNG cargo in 2016 and has since exported more than 3,300 cargoes to dozens of markets globally.
Job Summary:
 
In this role based in the Bechtel Houston Office, you will support subcontract formation and related contract management activities for assigned packages. Subcontract formation includes preparing and reviewing bid request packages, supporting development of project contract operating procedures, and coordinating required inputs from project stakeholders. You will be expected to independently manage routine to moderately complex subcontract formation activities, while receiving guidance from senior contracts personnel on high-risk, high-value, or unusually complex matters. Your work will help ensure subcontract compliance with project requirements and support effective execution of assigned scopes of work. 
"This position is designated as part-time telework per our global telework policy and will require at least three days of in-person attendance per week at the assigned office or project. Weekly in-person schedules will be determined by the individual and their supervisor, in consultation with functional or project leadership” 
#LI-CS1
Major Responsibilities:
 
Prepares bidders’ lists and pre-qualifies bidders

title: CSU Area Lead - ISBL
description:
Requisition ID: 294712
 
 
Relocation Authorized: National - Single
 
Telework Type: Full-Time Office/Project
 
Work Location: Brownsville, TX
 
Extraordinary teams building inspiring projects:
 
Since 1898, we have helped customers complete more than 25,000 projects in 160 countries on all seven continents that have created jobs, grown economies, improved the resiliency of the world's infrastructure, increased access to energy, resources, and vital services, and made the world a safer, cleaner place. 
Differentiated by the quality of our people and our relentless drive to deliver the most successful outcomes, we align our capabilities to our customers' objectives to create a lasting positive impact. We serve the Infrastructure; Nuclear, Security & Environmental; Energy; Mining & Metals, and the Manufacturing and Technology markets. Our services span from initial planning and investment, through start-up and operations. 
Core to Bechtel is our 
Vision, Values and Commitments
. They are what we believe, what customers can expect, and how we deliver. Learn more about our 
extraordinary teams building inspiring projects
 in our 
Impact Report
. 
Project Overview:
 
Bechtel is partnering with NextDecade to support their vision to provide the world access to lower carbon intensive energy with their Rio Grande LNG (RGLNG) project in Brownsville, Texas.RGLNG is a natural gas liquefaction and export terminal situated on a 984-acre site on the banks of the Brownsville ship channel. The first phase of the RGLNG project consists of three liquefaction trains, two storage tanks and one marine berth. At full capacity, the five-train facility will have a production capacity of 27 million tonnes per annum (MTPA). 
Brownsville, Texas is a city known for its diverse history, tradition, and rich culture. Located in the southernmost region in the beautiful state of Texas, lays Brownsville a rich, tropical oasis bordering the Rio Grande River and near the shores of the Gulf of Mexico. Brownsville embraces innovation, looks forward to the future and beyond! 
Job Summary:
 
This position will be responsible for supervising and directing CSU activities within the ISBL area with a focus on the Mechanical/Piping function. This will require coordinating with other disciplines within the CSU organization to complete all required testing from component level through integrated operation with the rest of the facility. They are responsible for ensuring CSU scope of the associated mechanical /piping work is completed on schedule, within budget, and in compliance with the project safety standards, the project quality standards, and the design/specifications; as well as performing general functions inherent in all home office and field positions. #LI-SP1
Major Responsibilities:
 
Reviews and evaluates proposed LNG project mechanical and piping design concepts.
Reviews and comments on Design documentation such as Basis of Design (BOD), Design Criteria, and Design Philosophy, and all relevant project specifications.
Examines mechanical designs and coordinates as needed to meet all other engineering disciplines’ requirements. Reviews and provides expert input on Equipment Datasheets, Plan drawings, Supplier documentation, etc.
Assesses and verifies the integrity of mechanical systems during Installation, Commissioning, and Startup, to maximize system reliability and availability, by carrying out inspections and construction support as needed.
Evaluates the installation of Vendor Packages against meeting compliance requirements and monitors equipment performance during commissioning and startup.
Provide ES&H leadership to personnel assigned to them. This includes preparation and implementation of safety procedures and leading Bechtel and subcontractor safety meetings.
Ensures that Bechtel and local/national safety codes, requirements and standards are being complied with within assigned area of responsibility. Ensures the Zero Accident Philosophy is incorporated into every aspect of Commissioning /Start up activities.
Actively participates in safety programs.
Receives operational surveillance, administrative supervision and technical guidance from commissioning and startup management. Objectives are defined, and results are subject to supervisory review. 
Establishes and maintains contacts with client, supplier, regulatory bodies, project management, engineering, and field personnel. Represents startup on project teams as assigned.
Supervises, coordinates, and reviews the work of assigned engineers, schedules, and assigns work to meet completion dates.
Performs employee performance reviews and identifies training and development opportunities for staff within area of responsibility.
Provides technical guidance and at times overall project startup supervision and assigns work to project Commissioning and Startup Mechanical engineers, technicians, crafts, and others who are performing specific assignments.
Coordinates between project engineering, construction, specialty staff groups, clients, and vendors.
Inputs to project management, engineering, and construction to ensure commissioning and startup requirements are incorporated into project activities, including review of project designs and construction to ensure plant operability and operating personnel safety.
Plans, schedules, conducts, or coordinates detailed phases of, commissioning, startup, operations, or maintenance for a project, including reviews of designs for plant operability and safety and jobsite commissioning and startup as directed. 
Performs work involving conventional practice but may include complex features such as conflicting priorities, unsuitability of conventional methods, or difficult coordination requirements.
Establishes and implements plans, instructions, procedures, and work process improvements to ensure the safe, timely, and economical delivery of Commissioning / Start up activities to meet project requirements.
Additional Responsibilities:
 
Prior to site mobilization, produces, reviews, or finalizes the following documentation:Scoped Mechanical Systems, Schedule sequence, Commissioning Site Execution Plan (Mechanical)
Assist in population of System Completions Database (Mechanical Items)
Inspection and Test Procedures as required. 
Integrates interdisciplinary schedule requirements and constraints to establish logical work sequences for assigned disciplines or specialties. 
Works with the contractors and others to coordinate work sequences with the total project plan.
Ensure permanent plant materials are stored in accordance with specifications and project requirements. 
Responsible for testing of mechanical system(s) as per suppliers and legislative requirements.
Prepares and Maintains Mechanical Spares for Commissioning and startup. 
Monitors Commissioning & Startup spares usage on the site and Prepares Field Material Requisitions for permanent plant material to ensures that the commissioning, Start up and Operations activities to be productive.
Responsible for jobsite operations including onsite activities of Bechtel, subcontractors, suppliers, clients and their representatives and others as may be assigned within area of responsibility.
Preparing reports and forecasts, including summary of CSU progress and craft personnel forecast.
Monitors the activities of subcontractors to ensure compliance with specifications and schedules.
Willingness to travel as business requirements dictate.
Education and Experience Requirements:
 
Requires bachelor's degree (or international equivalent) and 10-13  years of relevant experience or 14-17 years of relevant work experience
Required Knowledge and Skills:
 
Heavy industrial direct hire construction experience in a supervisory role commensurate with the type of work to be undertaken, preferably in a lump-sum turn-key environment.
The ideal candidate possesses extensive and a broad technical experience of commissioning, startup, operation, maintenance, and testing of Mechanical/Piping Systems/Components of Oil & Gas Processing Facilities.
Good Knowledge and Understanding of engineering systems, applications of startup and operations; and previous experience in Mechanical Commissioning roles.
Broad knowledge of industry and regulatory standards and criteria pertinent to startup, maintenance, operations, or testing.
Possesses effective communications skills crucial to motivating team members and presenting plans in a clear and concise manner. Collaborates well in a team environment.
Good leadership skills & able to supervise craft for testing, startup, and operations activity.
Good knowledge in MS Word, Excel, Visio, PowerPoint, and other relevant Bechtel used applications (Aconex, Set Route).
Understands project workflows from design, estimation, construction administration and coordination, and fabrication.
Preferred Qualifications:
 
Experience on an LNG construction site especially along the U.S. Gulf Coast.
Experience in the design of LNG facilities.
Experience with large refrigeration systems and compressors.
Experience with LNG facilities utilizing APCI C3MR technology
Understanding of applicable Bechtel work processes including Standard Work Process Procedures.
Familiarity with Bechtel Standard Applications (BSAPs) including Setroute, Unifier, Aconex, DSCS, PTR, Agile, Navisworks, and other automation tools which are used on Bechtel projects.
Strong supervision experience including the ability to lead and manage change.
 
Additional Information:
Must be willing to work a flexible schedule if required, including, but not limited to nightshift or split shift.
Work includes field inspections and the physical ability to conduct field inspections which require the following activities: extensive walking in and around a construction site, climbing ladders, climbing scaffolding, working on elevated platforms, working on uneven surfaces and working in small or confined spaces. Some lifting may be required. Must have the ability to walk into and out of the project (enter/egress). Must be able to use appropriate standard issued Personal Protection Equipment (PPE) required for each assigned task (i.e. harness, life vest, lift buckets, etc.).

title: Field Planner/Scheduler – Power Generation Construction
description:
Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries. 
Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success. 
Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions. 
We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world. 

Turner & Townsend 
is looking for a 
Construction Planner/Scheduler 
to join our team to provide scheduling services to our client for a major power generation buildout in West Texas. The ideal individual will have a good understanding of the project control’s function and will be primarily responsible for updating and maintaining the construction schedule.
*this role requires on site presence in Pecos, TX
Responsibilities
:
Ability to coordinate & organize multiple sources of schedule inputs/performance data into a master schedule platform and deliver project/program status reports as required. 
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. 
The tenacity and drive to inject value and create solutions. 
Develops good working relationships with project team. 
Implement project planning & scheduling strategy, plans and procedures, reflecting both Company and contractor roles, responsibilities and expectations. 
Manage schedule interfaces between contractors
Promote and maintain the overall integration and integrity of contractor schedules within the Program suite of project schedules.  
Provide interface and quality assurance to Project functional groups and contractors regarding the tracking and reporting of schedule performance. 
Support the project team in the implementation of an integrated enterprise based cross functional and EPC master schedule program. 
Preparing staffing, engineering and construction progress and customized reports. 
Perform critical path analysis. 
Perform probabilistic analysis on integrated schedules and contractor schedules. 
SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable.
Project/Program specifications:
Project/Program specific responsibilities: This role will work in tandem with other planner/schedulers on our team to support consistent site presence throughout the life cycle of the project. Role will be in rotation on site with accommodations and meals provided; six weeks on, two weeks off.
Market sector experience: Large scale Oil & Gas construction experience a must. Preferred candidate will have experience in power generation construction on both the EPC and Owner’s side.
Software specific requirements: Must have 10-15 years experience with Primavera P6 scheduling software for large-scale capital projects.
Certification requirements: Industry certifications a plus.

Bachelor’s degree in construction management, cost management, quantity surveying, engineering or field related to construction.
Minimum 10 years of applicable experience
Experience in the development, preparation, review, baselining of project schedules, with experience in critical path analysis.
Experience with scheduling and risk analysis programs such as Primavera P6, Acumen Fuse, etc.
Strong communication skills.

Highly competitive compensation offered.
*On site requirements may change depending on client needs.

title: Construction Cost Manager, NA Design & Construction Governance, Global Engineering Services, GEMS D&C, Cost Management
description:
The NA Design & Construction (D&C) Cost Management team within Global Engineering Services (GES) is seeking a passionate and motivated Construction Cost Manager to manage and support a portfolio of industrial construction projects in North America. In this role, you will drive cost certainty across multiple projects, reporting on overall financial health to organizational leaders and cross-functional stakeholders. Working independently and with cross-functional teams, you will execute cost management frameworks, validate project financials, and contribute to cost management best practices across the program.
This is an individual contributor role that operates with moderate autonomy on defined workstreams, seeking guidance from the Cost Management Manager on strategic direction while independently managing day-to-day cost functions across assigned projects. 
This role requires approximately 25% regional travel within North America, with potential travel to all North America locations based on business needs.
Key job responsibilities
Cost Management & Governance
•	Execute end-to-end cost management functions aligned, including cost planning, cost control, cost forecasting, and cost reporting across multiple assigned projects.
•	Maintain compliance with Amazon's internal cost management governance standards, including cost authority thresholds, approval workflows, and financial delegation of authority.
Budget Management & Cost Controls
•	Track and report cost performance metrics 
•	Implement and maintain cost control processes including cost baselines, work breakdown structures, and cost breakdown structures.
•	Create and maintain processes for timely cost variance identification and escalation per established thresholds.
•	Review, analyze, and challenge cost and time change requests from external partners 
•	Contingency  management and monthly cost reporting leveraging internal data and tools with a bias toward automation.
Change Management 
•	Strong fundamental understanding of end-to-end change control process management (receipt, evaluation, negotiation, disposition) with the ability to drive a standardized process leveraging AACE standards.
•	Ability to develop and review change order logs, commitment registers, and produce audit-trail documentation
•	Working with construction managers, support in the action of reviewing and validating change orders including proposed costs, scope of work, and comparison with contractual terms.
External Partner & Stakeholder Management
•	Develop strong partnerships with Construction Managers, Preconstruction Managers, Design, Procurement, Finance, and Operations teams.
•	Align cost reporting and estimating deliverables with external project managers, architects, general contractors, and consultants.
•	Independently identify project risks including financial cost impacts and communicate to the Cost Management Manager and cross-functional partners.
Communication & Reporting
•	Contribute to daily, weekly, and monthly cost reports with a bias toward automation.
•	Communicate cost metrics, trends, and recommendations effectively (verbal and written) to cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders.
Data Analytics & Technology
•	Explore and implement generative AI and automation tools to accelerate cost estimating, change order analysis, variance reporting, and lessons-learned extraction.
•	Strong fundamentals on cost management platforms (e.g., Procore, Ecosys, Oracle Unifier, or equivalent) and advanced Excel capabilities (Power Query, pivot tables, array formulas, macros) for cost tracking and analysis.
A day in the life
As a Construction Cost Manager, you will primarily work with Construction Managers and act as a strategic advisor on all cost functions across multiple projects. You will independently manage cost tracking, change order validation, and financial reporting for your assigned portfolio while collaborating with Finance, Planning, and Design teams to predict project costs at a network level. With an attention to diving deep, you will support financial white papers with data and analysis, identify cost savings opportunities, and drive process improvements within your workstream. You will make trade-offs between time, quality, and resources on your assigned projects, escalating strategic decisions to your manager as appropriate.

- Experience as an Architect, Engineer, Construction Manager, Development Manager, Owner's project management representative or in other Commercial Development and Construction related disciplines

description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
As a Data Center Project Engineer, you will be a part of a creative, diverse team tasked with solving fascinating problems constructing Amazon Data Centers. Our data centers are industry examples of energy efficient, cost-effective designs. You will work alongside partner teams such as Operations, Networking, Controls, Security, and Commissioning to build Data Centers that directly support our Customers.
As our Data Center Project Engineer, you will support the teams that build some of the most interesting electrical and mechanical systems in the world. You will be on the construction site, daily interacting with the construction managers and stakeholders and be directly responsible for supporting the fast, high-quality delivery of our data center construction. The Data Center Project Engineer will be part of the onsite Construction Management team and will own the communication coordination with our vendors, information workflow, and coordination of document management including requests for information (RFI), change orders, report, and schedule updates.
At Amazon, we are all Owners and leverage unique opportunities presented to us by owning everything from the design review to construction bidding to construction execution and final hand-off to our customers. We are a diverse, upbeat, creative, team of engineers and managers working on a daily basis to develop innovative data centers for our Customers.
Key job responsibilities
The Data Center Project Engineer will be responsible for:
 - Establishing communication and coordination across a data center region’s general contractors, stakeholders, and internal teams.  Example includes sending out region wide changes to construction trailer setup, or location to access documents.
 - Develop and maintain a tracking system for design changes, RFI’s (requests for information), and change orders and dashboard and track this information for regional leadership review.  Include tracking status of priority and due dates.
 - Requesting and reviewing MOPs (Method of Procedure) for proper detail, necessity, and risk. 
 - On-boarding new vendors for badging and orientation.
 - Updating project management software with milestone dates, correspondence, and documents.
 - Monitor delivery of owner furnished material to site.
 - Compiling and storing construction data from vendors.
 - Managing checklist including various checklists including substantial completion checks, safety, and quality.
 
A day in the life
Your morning starts on-site — checking OFCI delivery status, reviewing open submittals, and walking the building with your Construction Manager and general contractor. You'll coordinate with commissioning, design, procurement, and security teams to keep your workstreams moving. Afternoons might include updating punchlist trackers, preparing documentation packages for upcoming milestones, or onboarding new vendors. description:
Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries. 
Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success. 
Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions. 
We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world. 

Turner & Townsend 
is looking for a 
Construction Planner/Scheduler 
to join our team to provide scheduling services to our client for a major power generation buildout in West Texas. The ideal individual will have a good understanding of the project control’s function and will be primarily responsible for updating and maintaining the construction schedule.
*this role requires on site presence in Pecos, TX
Responsibilities
:
Ability to coordinate & organize multiple sources of schedule inputs/performance data into a master schedule platform and deliver project/program status reports as required. 
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. 
The tenacity and drive to inject value and create solutions. 
Develops good working relationships with project team. 
Implement project planning & scheduling strategy, plans and procedures, reflecting both Company and contractor roles, responsibilities and expectations. 
Manage schedule interfaces between contractors
Promote and maintain the overall integration and integrity of contractor schedules within the Program suite of project schedules.  
Provide interface and quality assurance to Project functional groups and contractors regarding the tracking and reporting of schedule performance. 
Support the project team in the implementation of an integrated enterprise based cross functional and EPC master schedule program. 
Preparing staffing, engineering and construction progress and customized reports. 
Perform critical path analysis. 
Perform probabilistic analysis on integrated schedules and contractor schedules. 
SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable.
Project/Program specifications:
Project/Program specific responsibilities: This role will work in tandem with other planner/schedulers on our team to support consistent site presence throughout the life cycle of the project. Role will be in rotation on site with accommodations and meals provided; six weeks on, two weeks off.
Market sector experience: Large scale Oil & Gas construction experience a must. Preferred candidate will have experience in power generation construction on both the EPC and Owner’s side.
Software specific requirements: Must have 10-15 years experience with Primavera P6 scheduling software for large-scale capital projects.
Certification requirements: Industry certifications a plus.

Bachelor’s degree in construction management, cost management, quantity surveying, engineering or field related to construction.
Minimum 10 years of applicable experience
Experience in the development, preparation, review, baselining of project schedules, with experience in critical path analysis.
Experience with scheduling and risk analysis programs such as Primavera P6, Acumen Fuse, etc.
Strong communication skills.

Highly competitive compensation offered.
*On site requirements may change depending on client needs.

title: Roadway, Bridge and Guideway Engineer
description:
About the Position

We’re seeking a 
Roadway, Bridge and Guideway Engineer
 to support large, heavy-civil infrastructure programs, including highways, roads, bridges, transit (both rail and bus), international airports, and water/wastewater projects delivered through both traditional and alternative methods. Your primary focus will be providing construction inspection and quality assurance oversight for roadway, bridge, guideway, and related structural elements on a large-scale passenger rail infrastructure program, serving as the owner’s representative in the field to verify that constructed work meets approved plans, specifications, and safety standards.

This is a long-term, full-time, on-site position 
located
 in the Central Valley region of California. Note: This position requires
 
100% travel
 to field sites within the designated 
area
.
 

Responsibilities
 
may include, but are not limited to, the following:

Perform daily field inspections of bridges, guideways, elevated structures, retaining walls, foundations, and related civil infrastructure to verify compliance with approved plans, specifications, and contract requirements.

Monitor construction activities involving structural concrete, reinforcing steel, prestressed and post-tensioned systems, structural steel erection, bearings, expansion joints, precast elements, falsework, and shoring operations.

Evaluate completed work against project quality requirements and applicable industry standards, and coordinate corrective actions with contractors, resident engineers, and quality assurance staff when non-conforming elements are identified.

Review and develop inspection and testing reports, material certifications, placement records, and quality control documentation for accuracy and completeness.

Document inspection findings, deficiencies, field observations, and project progress through photographs and electronic reporting systems.

Witness and record field testing, material sampling, structural load testing, and acceptance testing activities.

Coordinate inspection schedules with specialty inspectors, survey personnel, utility representatives, and other project stakeholders.

Verify implementation of approved traffic control, environmental compliance, and construction safety requirements within active inspection areas.

Participate in field coordination meetings and progress reviews to resolve technical and construction issues.

Support punch list development, substantial completion inspections, final acceptance documentation, and record verification during project closeout.

Attributes

Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.

Strong attention to detail and a firm commitment to safety, quality, and accountability.

Collaborative mindset that builds trust and effective working relationships with contractors, engineers, and project stakeholders.

Sound judgment and problem-solving ability when evaluating field conditions and non-conforming work.

Ability to work effectively in active construction environments and adapt to shifting project priorities.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering, construction management, engineering technology, or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Must be licensed to operate motor vehicles in accordance with California law and have 
the ability to travel to and between active construction sites.

5+ years of bridge, guideway, railroad, or heavy civil construction inspection experience.

Experience performing construction inspections and documenting field activities through detailed inspection records and reports.

Working knowledge of bridge, guideway, railroad, and heavy civil construction methods, structural systems, engineering plans, specifications, and contract documents.

Ability to interpret structural drawings, shop drawings, construction specifications, and inspection procedures.

Knowledge of quality assurance/quality control (QA/QC) principles and construction inspection practices.

Knowledge of construction safety, traffic control, and environmental compliance requirements applicable to active rail and highway construction sites.

Experience with industry standard project and construction management software (e.g., Primavera P6, TILOS, Procore, Unifier, FieldManager, or similar platforms).

Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite/Office 365 (e.g., Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.).

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in civil engineering, construction management, and engineering technology.

Certifications such as ACI Concrete Field Testing Technician Grade I, ICC Reinforced Concrete Special Inspector, AWS Certified Welding Inspector (CWI), or equivalent structural inspection certification, along with an OSHA 30-Hour Construction Safety certification.

10+ years of bridge, guideway, or railroad construction inspection experience on large transportation infrastructure programs.

Experience on passenger, commuter, or freight rail construction programs.

Knowledge of AASHTO, AREMA, and applicable state DOT bridge design and construction standards.

Familiarity or proficiency with Microsoft Power BI or other dashboard KPI reporting software.

description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Position Brand Description:
The Global Facilities Delivery (GFD) Organization, part of Corporate Engineering, delivers new and renovated capital assets around the world.  Our mission is accomplished through a highly leveraged organization of design, construction and qualification contractors.
Many of the assets delivered focus on manufacturing medical innovations and delivering innovative solutions to patients.  Some of the assets delivered support an expansion in supply of existing medicines.

Project Control Management:  Develop and manage project controls teams to deliver large capital programs of at least $500MM USD or more that are business-critical in nature. Manage and direct all aspects of project control on major capital projects including, establishing cost, schedule and resource plan baselines, managing resources, influencing good contract strategy, establishing change control and risk management, monitoring actual costs, auditing pay applications, contracts management, forecast and cashflows.

12+ years of project controls experience supporting large-scale industrial, manufacturing, pharmaceutical, energy, infrastructure, or capital construction projects.
Demonstrated expertise in cost management, planning and scheduling, forecasting, change management, and project risk management.
Willingness to relocate and/or travel domestically and internationally as required..
Additional Preferences:
Professional certification from a project control body such as RICS, AACE, or PMI.
Proficiency with project management systems, specifically SAP, Oracle Unifier, Primavera P6, SafranRisk, etc. ).
Advanced understanding in financial concepts and estimating, cost management theory, project change and risk management, project planning and scheduling, and work and cost breakdown structures.
Capacity to lead through influence to achieve results

Capacity to think strategically, taking a long view at how to achieve objectives.
Effective communication skills, both written and verbal
Self-disciplined, motivated, and able to work with limited supervision.
Excellent problem-solving skills and innovative thinking

title: Senior Program Manager, Data Governance & Analytics
description:
The Senior Program Manager, Data Governance & Analytics establishes and leads the data governance, reporting, and analytics strategy for Global Program Controls. This role is accountable for ensuring that portfolio delivery data is consistently defined, accurately maintained, appropriately governed, and translated into actionable insights for senior leadership.

As the recognized subject matter expert for program data and performance reporting, this individual will define the policies, standards, operating mechanisms, and analytical capabilities that enable trusted decision-making across the global portfolio. The role owns the authoritative delivery data framework, executive portfolio dashboards, operational reporting suite, data quality program, stewardship network, and reporting calendar.

This position operates across multiple organizations and systems, including Jira, Primavera Cloud, Apex, Unifier, financial platforms, and business intelligence tools. The Senior Program Manager will influence senior leaders, program controls teams, technology partners, finance organizations, and functional stakeholders to establish consistent data practices and improve portfolio visibility.

The successful candidate combines deep expertise in data governance, business intelligence, and program controls with strong executive communication and cross-functional leadership. This is a highly influential individual contributor role that leads enterprise-scale programs and processes through expertise, partnership, and strategic influence rather than direct people management.

Key Responsibilities

Data Governance Strategy and Leadership

Establish and lead the Global Program Controls Data Governance program, including its strategy, policies, standards, operating model, controls, and performance measures.

Develop the overarching data governance policy framework and ensure alignment with enterprise data, security, compliance, and technology requirements.

Define decision rights, ownership models, escalation paths, and governance forums for portfolio delivery data.

Advise leadership on data governance, reporting strategy, analytical capability, and portfolio performance measurement.

Evaluate emerging technologies, governance practices, and analytical approaches that can improve data quality, accessibility, automation, and decision-making.

Lead complex, cross-functional data initiatives that span multiple organizations, regions, business processes, and technology platforms.

 

Data Standards, Dictionary, and Lineage

Lead development and maintenance of the authoritative data dictionary for delivery data across Jira, Primavera Cloud, Unifier, financial systems, and reporting platforms.

Define standard business terms, metric definitions, calculation methodologies, source-system ownership, and acceptable-use requirements.

Establish and maintain data lineage documentation that maps data from source systems through integrations, transformations, semantic models, dashboards, and reports.

Ensure that key portfolio metrics have documented definitions, accountable owners, approved sources, and transparent calculation logic.

Resolve conflicting definitions and promote consistent use of data and metrics across teams and regions.

 

Data Quality and Issue Resolution

Define and enforce data quality rules for completeness, validity, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and uniqueness.

Establish scheduled data quality monitoring, automated validation checks, exception reporting, and data quality scorecards.

Create measurable data quality targets and communicate trends, gaps, and risks to leadership and data owners.

Operate the data issue resolution process, giving stakeholders a clear mechanism to report suspected data defects.

Lead root-cause analysis and corrective-action efforts for recurring or high-impact data issues.

Partner with system owners and business teams to address upstream process weaknesses rather than relying solely on downstream corrections.

Ensure executive and operational reports are validated for accuracy and completeness before distribution.

 

Master Data and Data Stewardship

Govern critical master and reference data, including canonical site names, project identifiers, regional hierarchies, organizational structures, program classifications, and reporting dimensions.

Establish and manage a cross-functional data stewardship network.

Identify data owners and stewards within each functional area and define their responsibilities, decision authority, and expected service levels.

Provide training, guidance, tools, and ongoing support to data stewards and contributors.

Facilitate governance forums that address data quality, definition changes, ownership gaps, and cross-system alignment.

Mentor peers and stakeholders on governance, reporting, data interpretation, and analytical best practices.

 

Executive Reporting and Analytics

Own the strategy, design, development, and ongoing maintenance of the global portfolio executive dashboard and operational reporting suite.

Translate complex program, schedule, cost, risk, and workflow data into clear, visually compelling insights for vice presidents and other senior leaders.

Establish reporting standards covering templates, visualization conventions, metric definitions, validation protocols, version control, distribution, and retention.

Manage the reporting calendar and ensure reports are produced, reviewed, approved, and distributed according to established cadences.

Respond to ad hoc leadership requests for custom analysis, scenario evaluation, and portfolio deep dives.

 

Systems and Data Partnerships

Partner with systems integration, data engineering, IT, and application teams to ensure reliable and scalable data flows.

Define business requirements for integrations, data models, reporting layers, controls, and workflow enhancements.

Partner with system owners to align data access policies with role-based access, confidentiality, security, and business requirements.

Assess the downstream reporting and governance impact of system, process, and data-model changes.

Ensure analytical products draw from governed, traceable, and trusted data sources.

Drive adoption of reusable data products and self-service reporting capabilities while maintaining appropriate governance and controls.

 

Stakeholder Leadership and Influence

Build and maintain a broad network across Global Program Controls, delivery organizations, finance, IT, data engineering, system administration, and senior leadership.

Lead through influence across teams where formal authority may not exist.

Communicate recommendations, risks, tradeoffs, and decisions to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Facilitate alignment among stakeholders with competing requirements, definitions, or priorities.

Represent Global Program Controls in enterprise data, reporting, and technology forums.

Provide coaching and mentorship to analysts, program managers, data stewards, and other peers across the line of business.

Foster inclusive collaboration by ensuring relevant stakeholders are represented in governance, reporting, and decision-making activities.

title: Oracle Cloud PPM Delivery Architect
description:
Oracle Cloud Project Portfolio Management Delivery Architect

JOB SUMMARY:

A Delivery Architect at Argano is a highly experienced professional in the consulting family responsible for providing solution leadership to mid to large size client engagements and contributing to the growth and development of the consulting practice. The ideal candidate will be a consummate professional who can thrive in an upbeat and innovative environment and collaborate with clients to deliver a state-of-the-art solution. The individual will excel at delivering high quality service and cutting-edge solutions to Argano clients in the Oracle community. The Oracle Cloud Delivery Architect will focus on guiding and assisting clients through all phases of Oracle ERP Cloud implementation. The Oracle Cloud Delivery Architect is expected to have expertise in implementing a wide range of Oracle Cloud applications. The successful candidate will have completed five successful Oracle Cloud implementations. An Oracle Cloud Delivery Architect is responsible for the overall Enterprise Cloud solution. The Delivery Architect will lead the implementation team in all phases of the implementation. This individual will identify and apply creative and innovative approaches to resolving product implementation and integration obstacles. They provide expert advice, guidance, and solutions related to technology to businesses and organizations. Their goal is to help clients optimize their technology infrastructure, processes, and strategies to achieve their business objectives more efficiently and effectively. 

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Lead mid to large size and complex consulting projects simultaneously.

Extensive whole lifecycle experience in leading Oracle SaaS requirements workshops, solutions architecture & design discussions

Using in-depth knowledge of Oracle Cloud Applications, as well as industry best practice expertise, consults with clients to provide cost effective solutions to client business scenarios.

Leads the implementation team in creating the overall Enterprise Cloud solution. This includes both the technical and functional solutions.

Experience in extending Oracle SaaS footprints with PaaS extensions. This involves designing solutions and writing specifications to create custom applications and integrating them with Oracle Cloud Applications

Analyze current systems and data to identify new requirements, recognizing the need for systems enhancements or modifications if necessary. 

Ability to Lead, mentor, train and guide an Oracle Cloud applications team. 

Experience in mapping enterprise requirements to multiple applications in the Oracle SaaS Applications 

Identifies and applies creative and innovative approaches to resolving product implementation and integration obstacles and problems.

Develop and implement long-term client strategies.

Act as the primary point of contact for clients. Effectively communicate with clients, team members, and stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle. Keep all parties informed about project progress, challenges, and changes.

Actively engage project stakeholders in the estimation process, mindful of the impact of strategic business changes.

Support business partners in presenting solution value to key stakeholders effectively.

Collaborate with third-party vendors and suppliers to source necessary hardware, software, or services. Negotiate contracts and agreements to secure the best terms for the client. 

Present compelling business cases, clearly quantifying the benefits of proposed solutions.

Continuously monitor the performance of implemented solutions to identify areas for improvement or optimization. Provide recommendations for updates, upgrades, or modifications as needed.

MINIMUM AND/OR PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION:

Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Engineering, etc.

MBA, relevant master's degree or PhD.

EXPERIENCE
:

Minimum 10 years of experience as Oracle Functional consultant with 3+ years of experience in solution design for Oracle Fusion Project Portfolio Management implementations.

Expert level experience as an Oracle Cloud Architect implementing or supporting Oracle Cloud PPM implementation projects and upgrades.

Experience with Oracle Platform as a Service (PaaS) with a focus on Integration Cloud Service, Database Cloud Service

Knowledgeable and experience with Web Services and the use of Oracle Cloud delivered Web Services (SOAP & REST)

Expert consulting experience and business analytical skills to gather and document business requirements, leading fit-gap analysis, business process designs, managing conference room pilots (CRPs), perform functional configuration, and manage testing of PPM solutions.

Experience in navigating the challenges of working with cross-border and diverse teams and projects.

Expert level experience with cloud PPM modules such as Project Execution Management, Project Billing, Costing, Resource Management, Contracts, Grants Management, and Project Performance Management 

Expert level experience with one or more of the following Oracle Cloud Applications:
  

Oracle ERP Cloud

Oracle Project Portfolio Management Cloud

Oracle Supply Chain Management Cloud

Oracle Manufacturing Cloud

Experience with Oracle Primavera Cloud, Primavera Unifier and Oracle Textura Payment Management would be a plus.

Strong consulting experience and business analytical skills to gather and document business requirements, leading fit-gap analysis, business process designs, managing conference room pilots (CRPs), and perform functional configuration.

Proven experience with guiding clients through business process improvements

Ability to analyze the industry's business process, complex project requirements and develop end to end solutions and functional design

Experience in project-intensive industries such as engineering and construction, industrial manufacturing, and public sectors is highly desired.

Excellent interpersonal, organizational, presentation, and communication skills

High commitment to exceed performance expectations.

Senior enough to be able to independently handle client expectations.

Professional approach when dealing with internal and external customers.

Ability to maintain a positive attitude under stressful circumstances.

Willingness to travel as needed.

Preferred consulting experience in a similar role in a professional services firm or industry experience at a strategic level is required.

Previous experience working in IT companies.

In-depth knowledge of the technologies and systems relevant.

Creating a positive environment by monitoring workloads of the team while meeting client expectations

SKILL REQUIREMENTS

Communication: 
Proficient in English written and verbal communications. Excellent verbal and written communication skills to interact with clients, team members, and stakeholders.

Complex Project Management:
 Delivery Architects are responsible for leading multiple complex projects, necessitating exceptional project management skills.

Thought Leadership
: Providing thought leadership and industry expertise is critical in projects.

Client Acquisition:
 They should have strong business development skills to acquire new clients and expand existing relationships.

Mentorship and Coaching:
 Indirectly developing and coaching junior and mid-level consultants is a significant responsibility.

Strategic Vision:
 Delivery Architects should contribute to the firm's strategic vision and decision-making.

Executive Presence:
 The ability to interact effectively with senior client executives is important.

Project Overview:
 
Bechtel is the licensing, engineering, procurement, and construction partner on TerraPower’s Natrium team. Selected by the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) for its Advanced Reactor Demonstration Program, Natrium is participating in a DOE initiative to re-establish U.S. leadership in nuclear energy that provides matching funding to industry to design and build an operational advanced reactor. TerraPower, a leading advanced generation technology company founded by former Microsoft CEO Bill Gates, will be deploying its 345 MWe sodium fast reactor (SFR), called Natrium. The Natrium plant features an advanced, cost-competitive reactor design that is safer, simpler, easier, less costly to construct, less expensive to operate, and able to provide energy that is competitive with fossil fuels. It also features an innovative molten salt energy storage system designed to be complementary to solar and wind power by evening out the peaks and valleys in production when the sun is not shining, or the wind is not blowing. With the reactor and energy storage output combined, the plant can produce more than 500 MWe of power.

title: PMIS Configuration Consultant
description:
About the Position

We’re seeking a 
PMIS Configuration Consultant
 to configure, implement, and support project management information systems on large-scale, heavy-civil infrastructure programs across highways, roads and bridges, transit (rail and bus), aviation, and water sectors. You’ll build out PMIS modules for budget, cost, schedule, risk, and reporting, and partner with project controls teams to keep program data structured, accurate, and audit ready.

This is a long-term, full-time, hybrid position located in Oakland, CA, that will require up to 50% travel.

Responsibilities
 
may include, but are not limited to, the following:

Configure PMIS processes for budget, cost, change orders, payments, risk, issues, cash flow, and earned value to support project controls, project management, and program management functions.

Configure security roles, user access, and integrations between PMIS platforms, scheduling systems, document management systems, and ERP systems.

Configure cash flow, earned value, and other modules within the PMIS solution.

Identify and correct inconsistencies in data structures, coding, and hierarchy across project controls systems.

Develop and maintain data models that support integrated reporting across cost, schedule, and performance metrics, and drive continuous improvement of data structures, reporting processes, and data quality across the program.

Develop project reports and dashboards aligned with client and program reporting requirements.

Automate data extraction, transformation, and reconciliation across PMIS and integrated systems using SQL and/or Python.

Reconcile and validate data across multiple reporting systems to maintain accuracy and consistency.

Collaborate with project controls managers, cost engineers, and schedulers to ensure data structures support program controls requirements.

Support end-user training and knowledge transfer on deployed PMIS configurations, workflows, and reporting tools.

Attributes

Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical project data into clear reporting for program leadership and stakeholders.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex datasets and identify meaningful insights.

High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.

Ability to manage multiple data sources and competing reporting deadlines across large, complex programs.

Collaborative mindset that supports project controls managers, cost engineers, and schedulers in achieving shared reporting goals.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, construction management, business administration (management information systems), data analytics, statistics, or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

3+ years of experience implementing and configuring one or more of the following PMIS solutions: Unifier, P6, Kahua, or Procore.

Experience supporting project controls, data, or reporting functions on large, complex infrastructure programs, including highways, roads, bridges, transit (rail or bus), aviation, or water/wastewater projects, typically involving multi-contract delivery and integrated reporting requirements.

In-depth understanding of project controls processes and their relationships to budget, schedule, risk, and governance on large infrastructure programs.

Experience performing advanced data manipulation, transformation, and structuring of large datasets, beyond basic reporting or dashboarding.

Experience working with hierarchical data structures such as work breakdown structures (WBS), cost breakdown structures (CBS), or similar multi-level coding frameworks.

Experience integrating, reconciling, and normalizing data across multiple systems, such as scheduling, cost, and financial systems.

Experience improving data quality, hierarchy, and alignment across systems when working with incomplete, inconsistent, or poorly structured datasets.

Proficiency with SQL and Python.

Proficiency with Microsoft Office 365 (e.g., Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.).

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree in engineering, computer science, construction management, business administration (management information systems), data analytics, or statistics.

PMP (PMI), CCM (CMAA), MRICS/FRICS (RICS), or CCA (AACE).

Experience integrating PMIS solutions via API with analytics platforms or AI-assisted reporting tools, along with familiarity with applicable cybersecurity governance requirements.

Experience operating within a Center of Excellence model, including development of templates, processes, and governance that support efficient PMIS configuration and delivery.

Experience supporting integrated cost and schedule reporting, including earned value or similar performance frameworks.

Experience supporting project controls or program management on infrastructure programs exceeding $500M in value.

Familiarity or proficiency with Microsoft Power BI, Oracle Cloud Analytics, or other dashboard KPI reporting software.
